flaw.a_deal_with_the_devil.name: A Deal with the Devil
flaw.a_deal_with_the_devil.summary: The character has sold his soul to the devil and now finds himself destined to infernal damnation.

flaw.abandoned_apprentice.name: Abandoned Apprentice
flaw.abandoned_apprentice.summary: The character was abandoned by his master midway through his Hermetic training.

flaw.ability_block.name: Ability Block
flaw.ability_block.summary: You are completely unable to learn a certain class of Abilities, for some reason.

flaw.afflicted_tongue.name: Afflicted Tongue
flaw.afflicted_tongue.summary: You have a speech impediment, such as a lisp, stutter, or missing teeth.

flaw.age_quickly.name: Age Quickly
flaw.age_quickly.summary: Probably due to a curse or a magical disaster, you age twice as fast as normal people.

flaw.ambitious_major.name: Ambitious (Major)
flaw.ambitious_major.summary: You want to be the most successful or powerful person in the world in some respect.

flaw.ambitious_minor.name: Ambitious (Minor)
flaw.ambitious_minor.summary: You want to be the most successful or powerful person in the world in some respect.

flaw.anchored_to_the_land.name: Anchored to the {land}
flaw.anchored_to_the_land.summary: The character suffers from feelings of loneliness and depression when she cannot see or hear a particular type of environment.

flaw.animal_companion.name: Animal Companion
flaw.animal_companion.summary: You are accompanied by a loyal, intelligent (but mundane) animal that can obey simple commands.

flaw.apostate.name: Apostate
flaw.apostate.summary: You have converted from one faith to another or from one set of beliefs to another.

flaw.arthritis.name: Arthritis
flaw.arthritis.summary: Your joints are stiff and often painful, making almost any prolonged movement difficult.

flaw.avaricious_major.name: Avaricious (Major)
flaw.avaricious_major.summary: You want money, lots of money.

flaw.avaricious_minor.name: Avaricious (Minor)
flaw.avaricious_minor.summary: You want money, lots of money.

flaw.baneful_circumstances.name: Baneful Circumstances
flaw.baneful_circumstances.summary: Something about the character's supernatural nature weakens him in relatively common circumstances, such as when touching the ground or when in the presence of women.

flaw.beloved_rival_major.name: Beloved Rival (Major)
flaw.beloved_rival_major.summary: For a Minor Story Flaw, the character has a rival who is both fiercely protective of him and obsessed with opposing him at every turn.

flaw.beloved_rival_minor.name: Beloved Rival (Minor)
flaw.beloved_rival_minor.summary: For a Minor Story Flaw, the character has a rival who is both fiercely protective of him and obsessed with opposing him at every turn.

flaw.bigamist.name: Bigamist
flaw.bigamist.summary: The character has two entirely separate lives, in two cities, and moves between the two on some pretext, most likely trade.

flaw.black_sheep.name: Black Sheep
flaw.black_sheep.summary: Estranged from a prestigious family; a bad Reputation at level 2 among those who respect them.

flaw.blackmail.name: Blackmail
flaw.blackmail.summary: You have information that some powerful person would prefer kept hidden.

flaw.blatant_gift.name: Blatant Gift
flaw.blatant_gift.summary: Your Gift is extremely disturbing to others.

flaw.blatant_magical_air.name: Blatant Magical Air
flaw.blatant_magical_air.summary: Only characters with a Magical Air or The Gift may take this Flaw.

flaw.blind.name: Blind
flaw.blind.summary: You have little or no sight.

flaw.bound_casting_tools.name: Bound Casting Tools
flaw.bound_casting_tools.summary: The magus's casting tools, as used by House Verditius, are so personal that they become lasting Arcane Connections to him.

flaw.bound_magic.name: Bound Magic
flaw.bound_magic.summary: When you die, all of your spells end abruptly and any magic items that you created cease to function.

flaw.bound_to_realm.name: Bound to {realm}
flaw.bound_to_realm.summary: The character is no longer able to survive in the mundane world, and sickens if it is outside a particular sort of supernatural aura for an extended period of time.

flaw.bound_to_role_role.name: Bound to {role} Role
flaw.bound_to_role_role.summary: This character is physically bonded to some form of device, whether through a mystic event, long years of exposure and warping, or the ministrations of an experimental magus.

flaw.branded_criminal.name: Branded Criminal
flaw.branded_criminal.summary: As punishment for some crime in your past, a mark has been burned into your cheek.

flaw.broken_vessel.name: Broken Vessel
flaw.broken_vessel.summary: The character is constantly aware that her supernatural powers may only be temporary.

flaw.brutal_artist.name: Brutal Artist
flaw.brutal_artist.summary: This Flaw is only available to magi of House Jerbiton.

flaw.busybody.name: Busybody
flaw.busybody.summary: You usually know everything that is going on among your friends and acquaintances, especially in private matters.

flaw.carefree.name: Carefree
flaw.carefree.summary: You are unshakably cheerful and happy in all circumstances.

flaw.careless_sorcerer.name: Careless Sorcerer
flaw.careless_sorcerer.summary: You are slapdash in your use of magical power, and must roll two more botch dice than normal when casting spells.

flaw.careless_with_ability.name: Careless with {ability}
flaw.careless_with_ability.summary: The character is particularly reckless when it comes to a particular Ability, chosen when this Virtue is taken.

flaw.castratus.name: Castratus
flaw.castratus.summary: You were castrated before puberty, leaving you beardless and somewhat effeminate compared to most men.

flaw.ceremonial_spontaneous_magic.name: Ceremonial Spontaneous Magic
flaw.ceremonial_spontaneous_magic.summary: You need time and effort to focus your Spontaneous magic.

flaw.church_upbringing.name: Church Upbringing
flaw.church_upbringing.summary: This Flaw covers children schooled by the Church and mostly raised by clerics as well, a fate befalling some orphans, bastards, Gifted children, and other misfits.

flaw.close_family_ties.name: Close Family Ties
flaw.close_family_ties.summary: Your family is one of the most important things in your life, and still supports and aids you whenever possible, even at personal risk.

flaw.clumsy.name: Clumsy
flaw.clumsy.summary: You are not very graceful and tend to drop things — you are at –3 in all related rolls.

flaw.clumsy_magic.name: Clumsy Magic
flaw.clumsy_magic.summary: You have trouble targeting your spells accurately.

flaw.companion_animal.name: Companion Animal
flaw.companion_animal.summary: The character is the Animal Companion of another character (either a player character or a storyguide character) and therefore has little control over his own life.

flaw.compassionate_major.name: Compassionate (Major)
flaw.compassionate_major.summary: You help anyone who is wounded or in trouble.

flaw.compassionate_minor.name: Compassionate (Minor)
flaw.compassionate_minor.summary: You help anyone who is wounded or in trouble.

flaw.compulsion_major.name: Compulsion (Major)
flaw.compulsion_major.summary: You have an unfortunate urge that you have trouble resisting.

flaw.compulsion_minor.name: Compulsion (Minor)
flaw.compulsion_minor.summary: You have an unfortunate urge that you have trouble resisting.

flaw.compulsive_lying_major.name: Compulsive Lying (Major)
flaw.compulsive_lying_major.summary: Telling the truth is really hard for this character.

flaw.compulsive_lying_minor.name: Compulsive Lying (Minor)
flaw.compulsive_lying_minor.summary: Telling the truth is really hard for this character.

flaw.consumed_casting_tools.name: Consumed Casting Tools
flaw.consumed_casting_tools.summary: The character's casting tools are magically consumed after he uses them.

flaw.continence.name: Continence
flaw.continence.summary: You do not engage in sexual activity.

flaw.corrupted_abilities.name: Corrupted Abilities
flaw.corrupted_abilities.summary: One or more of the character's Abilities was taught to her by a demon, or came through some other corrupted source of study.

flaw.corrupted_arts.name: Corrupted Arts
flaw.corrupted_arts.summary: The character has studied one of the Hermetic Arts from a corrupted source.

flaw.corrupted_spells.name: Corrupted Spells
flaw.corrupted_spells.summary: The character has learned at least 30 levels of formulaic spells from a source that has been corrupted in some way.

flaw.covenant_upbringing.name: Covenant Upbringing
flaw.covenant_upbringing.summary: You were raised in a large, old covenant that has little contact with the outside world.

flaw.craving_for_travel.name: Craving for Travel
flaw.craving_for_travel.summary: The character suffers from feelings of loneliness, boredom, and depression if he does not expose himself to new experiences.

flaw.creative_block.name: Creative Block
flaw.creative_block.summary: You have problems creating new things in the lab.

flaw.crippled.name: Crippled
flaw.crippled.summary: You either have no legs, or your legs are completely useless.

flaw.curse_of_slander.name: Curse of Slander
flaw.curse_of_slander.summary: Wherever he stays, unpleasant rumors and ill-favored stories about this character begin to spread within a short time.

flaw.curse_of_venus.name: Curse of Venus
flaw.curse_of_venus.summary: You are very attractive to people whom you do not wish to attract.

flaw.cursed_guile.name: Cursed Guile
flaw.cursed_guile.summary: This is the Flaw for "the boy who cried wolf," and probably results from Infernal influence.

flaw.cyclic_magic_negative.name: Cyclic Magic (negative)
flaw.cyclic_magic_negative.summary: As with the Hermetic Virtue, your magic is attuned to some cycle of nature and is less potent at specific times.

flaw.dark_secret.name: Dark Secret
flaw.dark_secret.summary: You are haunted by something that would lead to shame, rejection, and possibly revenge if discovered.

flaw.deficient_form.name: Deficient Form
flaw.deficient_form.summary: Almost all totals (including Casting Totals and Lab Totals, but excluding Magic Resistance) to which a particular Form is added are halved.

flaw.deficient_technique.name: Deficient {technique}
flaw.deficient_technique.summary: You are unable to use one Technique effectively.

flaw.deleterious_circumstances.name: Deleterious Circumstances
flaw.deleterious_circumstances.summary: All your magic totals, excluding Magic Resistance, are halved under certain uncommon circumstances.

flaw.delusion.name: Delusion
flaw.delusion.summary: You believe wholeheartedly in something that just isn't so.

flaw.demonic_familiar.name: Demonic Familiar
flaw.demonic_familiar.summary: The character is bound to a famulus, a familiar demon that possesses an animal and can lend the character its senses, or mask the evil taint of her Powers.

flaw.dependent.name: Dependent
flaw.dependent.summary: You feel responsible for someone, and bound to help if they are in trouble.

flaw.depraved_major.name: Depraved (Major)
flaw.depraved_major.summary: The character seeks to undermine religion whenever possible, and generally tries to avoid the Dominion.

flaw.depraved_minor.name: Depraved (Minor)
flaw.depraved_minor.summary: The character seeks to undermine religion whenever possible, and generally tries to avoid the Dominion.

flaw.depressed.name: Depressed
flaw.depressed.summary: You have a dark outlook on life, seeing little point in acting and taking no pleasure in anything that happens.

flaw.deteriorating_power.name: Deteriorating Power
flaw.deteriorating_power.summary: Like the Variable Powers Virtue, this Flaw reduces the effectiveness of one of the character's powers (Greater, Lesser, or Ritual) over time.

flaw.devoted_parent.name: Devoted Parent/Child
flaw.devoted_parent.summary: The character is extremely attached to a parent or child.

flaw.dhimmi.name: Dhimmi
flaw.dhimmi.summary: You are a non-Muslim living under Muslim rule.

flaw.diabolic_past.name: Diabolic Past
flaw.diabolic_past.summary: You were associated with diabolists, and though you have escaped their evil ways, you are still haunted by your upbringing and the memory of acts best left unspoken.

flaw.difficult_longevity_ritual.name: Difficult Longevity Ritual
flaw.difficult_longevity_ritual.summary: Something in your magical nature makes it difficult to create an effective Longevity Ritual for you.

flaw.difficult_spontaneous_magic.name: Difficult Spontaneous Magic
flaw.difficult_spontaneous_magic.summary: Spontaneous magic is always an effort for you.

flaw.difficult_underlings.name: Difficult Underlings
flaw.difficult_underlings.summary: You may only take this Story Flaw if your character has, and will keep, underlings of some sort or another.

flaw.disfigured.name: Disfigured
flaw.disfigured.summary: A visible disfigurement makes you ugly and easy to recognize.

flaw.disjointed_magic.name: Disjointed Magic
flaw.disjointed_magic.summary: You cannot use previous knowledge to help you with magic.

flaw.disorientating_magic.name: Disorientating Magic
flaw.disorientating_magic.summary: After casting a spell, you must spend a round doing nothing but recovering your mental faculties.

flaw.driven_major.name: Driven (Major)
flaw.driven_major.summary: You have some goal which you are determined to bring about.

flaw.driven_minor.name: Driven (Minor)
flaw.driven_minor.summary: You have some goal which you are determined to bring about.

flaw.dutybound.name: Dutybound
flaw.dutybound.summary: You follow a restrictive code of conduct out of guilt or fear.

flaw.dwarf.name: Dwarf
flaw.dwarf.summary: You are the size of a child.

flaw.employed_by_company.name: Employed by Company
flaw.employed_by_company.summary: Characters with this Flaw are salaried employees, answerable to an employer, which is normally a merchant company.

flaw.enemies.name: Enemies
flaw.enemies.summary: Someone is causing trouble for you, such as a local baron or bishop, a band of outlaws, or a really nasty innkeeper.

flaw.enfeebled.name: Enfeebled
flaw.enfeebled.summary: You cannot exert yourself for longer than a few seconds.

flaw.envied_beauty.name: Envied Beauty
flaw.envied_beauty.summary: The character's beauty draws revulsion and jealousy.

flaw.envious_major.name: Envious (Major)
flaw.envious_major.summary: You believe that everyone has it better than you do, and that they don't deserve their good fortune, while you do.

flaw.envious_minor.name: Envious (Minor)
flaw.envious_minor.summary: You believe that everyone has it better than you do, and that they don't deserve their good fortune, while you do.

flaw.environmental_magic_condition.name: Environmental Magic Condition
flaw.environmental_magic_condition.summary: All of the character's Casting and Lab Totals are halved in certain common conditions related to his environment, for example, whenever he is inside.

flaw.environmental_sensitivity.name: Environmental Sensitivity
flaw.environmental_sensitivity.summary: The character is unusually sensitive to an uncommon environmental feature, such as bad air, salt water, or extreme temperatures.

flaw.evil_destiny.name: Evil Destiny
flaw.evil_destiny.summary: The Infernal realm has taken an interest in the character, but he does not know how or why.

flaw.evil_eye.name: Evil Eye
flaw.evil_eye.summary: You character bears the Evil Eye, the uncontrolled potential to bring harm to others around her.

flaw.exciting_experimentation.name: Exciting Experimentation
flaw.exciting_experimentation.summary: Your character's experiments tend to have a flair for the ...

flaw.excommunicate.name: Excommunicate
flaw.excommunicate.summary: For your crimes against God and the Church, you have been cast out of your faith, undoing your baptism and driving you from your religious community.

flaw.exiled_atlantean.name: Exiled Atlantean
flaw.exiled_atlantean.summary: The character is an exiled Atlantean, she is tainted by her contact with the surface world, and cannot return to her magic regio.

flaw.faerie_friend.name: Faerie Friend
flaw.faerie_friend.summary: You have an ally among the fay, a boon that can also be a burden.

flaw.faerie_upbringing.name: Faerie Upbringing
flaw.faerie_upbringing.summary: Perhaps you were abandoned by your true kin, and the faeries found you.

flaw.failed_journeyman.name: Failed Journeyman
flaw.failed_journeyman.summary: The character has been expelled from a guild due to past illegal or questionable practices.

flaw.failed_master.name: Failed Master
flaw.failed_master.summary: Either through faulty management or illegal business practices, the character has run his workshop into the ground.

flaw.failed_monk.name: Failed Monk
flaw.failed_monk.summary: You were once a member of a cloistered order, but were cast out for some great sin or gross incompetence, or perhaps you ran away and your abbot might allow you to come back after a suitable punishment.

flaw.failed_student.name: Failed Student
flaw.failed_student.summary: The character has studied for a specific university license and failed his final examination.

flaw.false_power.name: False Power (Major)
flaw.false_power.summary: One of the character's Supernatural Virtues is associated with the Infernal realm, in addition to the realm with which it would normally be associated, which causes it to appear unholy when subjected to Divine or Infernal investigation.

flaw.false_power_minor.name: False Power (Minor)
flaw.false_power_minor.summary: One of the character's Supernatural Virtues is associated with the Infernal realm, in addition to the realm with which it would normally be associated, which causes it to appear unholy when subjected to Divine or Infernal investigation.

flaw.favors.name: Favors
flaw.favors.summary: You owe a boon to someone (or to a great many people), and may be called upon to return the favor at any time.

flaw.fear.name: Fear
flaw.fear.summary: You are scared of something that you are likely to encounter fairly often.

flaw.feral_scent.name: Feral Scent
flaw.feral_scent.summary: Perhaps due to his beast blood or feral upbringing, the character has the strong natural smell of a wild animal.

flaw.feral_upbringing.name: Feral Upbringing
flaw.feral_upbringing.summary: You grew up in the wilderness, either raised by wild animals or surviving on your own.

flaw.fettered_magic.name: Fettered Magic
flaw.fettered_magic.summary: All of your spells and the effects of any magic items you activate are Arcane Connections to you.

flaw.feud.name: Feud
flaw.feud.summary: Your family is involved in a feud.

flaw.fickle_nature.name: Fickle Nature
flaw.fickle_nature.summary: The character swings between two types of personality behaviors that are directly opposite.

flaw.fish_out_of_water_terrain.name: Fish Out of Water {terrain}
flaw.fish_out_of_water_terrain.summary: This character has an affinity with one type of terrain, whether this is at sea, in the woods, the rolling hills, or in the urban landscape of towns and cities, and feels uncomfortable and awkward when away from where he wants to be.

flaw.flashbacks.name: Flashbacks
flaw.flashbacks.summary: When engaged in combat, or a similar violent and tense situation, the stress might trigger a flashback to the horrors of past battles, which left this character mentally scarred.

flaw.flawed_parma_magica.name: Flawed Parma Magica
flaw.flawed_parma_magica.summary: Your Parma Magica is defective and provides only half the normal Magic Resistance against a certain Form.

flaw.flawed_powers.name: Flawed Powers
flaw.flawed_powers.summary: The character must have at least one Major Supernatural Virtue to take this Flaw.

flaw.fluctuating_fortune.name: Fluctuating Fortune
flaw.fluctuating_fortune.summary: The character's finances rise and fall like the tide, regardless of how successful he is or what preventative measures he takes.

flaw.follower.name: Follower
flaw.follower.summary: The character is a follower, not a leader.

flaw.foreign_upbringing.name: Foreign Upbringing
flaw.foreign_upbringing.summary: This Flaw is somewhat similar to Covenant Upbringing, but means that the character is a foreigner and comes from a remote or isolated corner of Mythic Europe.

flaw.form_monstrosity.name: {form} Monstrosity
flaw.form_monstrosity.summary: This Flaw is primarily intended for animal characters, but may be taken for characters who are basically human with the approval of the troupe.

flaw.frail.name: Frail
flaw.frail.summary: The character is weak of build and easily hurt when undertaking physical activities.

flaw.fury.name: Fury
flaw.fury.summary: A violent temper sometimes overwhelms you, sending you into a destructive, uncontrollable rage.

flaw.gabai.name: Gabai
flaw.gabai.summary: Appointed by the community council, the gabai is the local tax collector.

flaw.gender_nonconforming_major.name: Gender Nonconforming (Major)
flaw.gender_nonconforming_major.summary: You do not conform to the expected behavior for a person of the gender that your society would assign to you in the absence of social cues such as clothes and behavior.

flaw.gender_nonconforming_minor.name: Gender Nonconforming (Minor)
flaw.gender_nonconforming_minor.summary: You do not conform to the expected behavior for a person of the gender that your society would assign to you in the absence of social cues such as clothes and behavior.

flaw.generous_major.name: Generous (Major)
flaw.generous_major.summary: You willingly give away your property to anyone who expresses a desire for it, even if they are not particularly deserving.

flaw.generous_minor.name: Generous (Minor)
flaw.generous_minor.summary: You willingly give away your property to anyone who expresses a desire for it, even if they are not particularly deserving.

flaw.greater_malediction.name: Greater Malediction
flaw.greater_malediction.summary: You have been cursed by some supernatural power, in a way that greatly hinders you.

flaw.greedy_major.name: Greedy (Major)
flaw.greedy_major.summary: You like to eat and drink, and do so to excess whenever given the chance.

flaw.greedy_minor.name: Greedy (Minor)
flaw.greedy_minor.summary: You like to eat and drink, and do so to excess whenever given the chance.

flaw.grudge.name: Grudge
flaw.grudge.summary: For some reason, based on a past event, the character holds a strong grudge against someone who is part of his normal social circles, and with whom he would be expected to have cordial relations.

flaw.gullible.name: Gullible
flaw.gullible.summary: There is one born every minute - and it is this character!

flaw.hallucinations.name: Hallucinations
flaw.hallucinations.summary: The character is afflicted by vivid hallucinations which seem to be true visions, but rather than coming from a higher power, they are figments of her imagination and fantasy.

flaw.harmless_magic.name: Harmless Magic
flaw.harmless_magic.summary: The character's Perdo spells cannot permanently destroy anything; they temporarily disrupt the target, like Perdo Imaginem magic, but as soon as the duration has passed the target returns to its natural state as if nothing had happened, like a Muto effect.

flaw.hatred_major.name: Hatred (Major)
flaw.hatred_major.summary: You hate someone or some group so much that hurting them dominates your life.

flaw.hatred_minor.name: Hatred (Minor)
flaw.hatred_minor.summary: You hate someone or some group so much that hurting them dominates your life.

flaw.hedge_wizard.name: Hedge Wizard
flaw.hedge_wizard.summary: Because of your esoteric magic, other magi distrust you, and more importantly, grant you no respect.

flaw.heir.name: Heir
flaw.heir.summary: You have little power or wealth now, but you stand to inherit land and possibly money.

flaw.hermetic_patron.name: Hermetic Patron
flaw.hermetic_patron.summary: You must be a Redcap or magus to take this Flaw.

flaw.higher_purpose_major.name: Higher Purpose (Major)
flaw.higher_purpose_major.summary: Let others concern themselves with petty matters, you have a nobler goal.

flaw.higher_purpose_minor.name: Higher Purpose (Minor)
flaw.higher_purpose_minor.summary: Let others concern themselves with petty matters, you have a nobler goal.

flaw.hobbled.name: Hobbled
flaw.hobbled.summary: Both of the character's legs are severely damaged.

flaw.horrifying_appearance_snake_legs.name: Horrifying Appearance – Snake Legs
flaw.horrifying_appearance_snake_legs.summary: You have no legs, and instead your hips give rise to two or more snake-like tails; you should consider how you survived childhood with this horrific deformity.

flaw.humble.name: Humble
flaw.humble.summary: You are humble, always willing to believe that others are more skilled and better than you.

flaw.hunchback.name: Hunchback
flaw.hunchback.summary: You have a deformed body that gives you a grotesque appearance and hinders your movements.

flaw.hunger_for_form_magic.name: Hunger for {form} Magic
flaw.hunger_for_form_magic.summary: The character has been repeatedly exposed to magic and has thus become dependent upon magic to survive.

flaw.imagined_folk_tradition_vulnerabili.name: Imagined Folk Tradition Vulnerability
flaw.imagined_folk_tradition_vulnerabili.summary: Although this flaw closely resembles a Delusion, Imagined Folk Tradition Vulnerability has other game mechanical effects as well.

flaw.impious_friend.name: Impious Friend
flaw.impious_friend.summary: A minor demon poses as a friend of the character.

flaw.incompatible_arts.name: Incompatible Arts
flaw.incompatible_arts.summary: For some reason you are completely unable to use two combinations of Techniques and Forms.

flaw.incomprehensible.name: Incomprehensible
flaw.incomprehensible.summary: You are almost completely unable to convey the knowledge and understanding that you have.

flaw.inconstant_magic.name: Inconstant Magic
flaw.inconstant_magic.summary: The character's magic is easily distracted, and it stutters and starts.

flaw.independent_craftsman.name: Independent Craftsman
flaw.independent_craftsman.summary: This character has his own way of working and doesn't like other people getting in his way.

flaw.indiscreet.name: Indiscreet
flaw.indiscreet.summary: You are unable to keep a secret.

flaw.infamous.name: Infamous
flaw.infamous.summary: A level-4 bad Reputation for horrible deeds of your choosing.

flaw.infamous_master.name: Infamous Master
flaw.infamous_master.summary: Your master was a diabolist, bumbler, fool, widely despised, or held in contempt for some other reason.

flaw.inscribed_shadow.name: Inscribed Shadow
flaw.inscribed_shadow.summary: The character's stigmata are reflected by glowing symbols in the character's shadow.

flaw.jinxed.name: Jinxed
flaw.jinxed.summary: The character is a magnet for any bad luck.

flaw.judged_unfairly.name: Judged Unfairly
flaw.judged_unfairly.summary: Somehow you come across the wrong way to people, and they universally distrust and underestimate you.

flaw.lame.name: Lame
flaw.lame.summary: One of your legs is weakened, whether since birth or through some accident.

flaw.lecherous_major.name: Lecherous (Major)
flaw.lecherous_major.summary: You seek sexual contact with as many people as possible.

flaw.lecherous_minor.name: Lecherous (Minor)
flaw.lecherous_minor.summary: You seek sexual contact with as many people as possible.

flaw.lesser_malediction.name: Lesser Malediction
flaw.lesser_malediction.summary: You have been cursed by some supernatural power.

flaw.limited_magic_resistance.name: Limited Magic Resistance
flaw.limited_magic_resistance.summary: You are less able to resist magic than other magi.

flaw.lingering_injury.name: Lingering Injury
flaw.lingering_injury.summary: The character suffers from an old injury that won't heal properly, resulting in a –1 penalty to all rolls involving physical activity.

flaw.loose_magic.name: Loose Magic
flaw.loose_magic.summary: Your Advancement Total is halved whenever you try to Master spells.

flaw.lost_love.name: Lost Love
flaw.lost_love.summary: You have lost your true love to death, distance, or marriage.

flaw.low_self_esteem.name: Low Self-Esteem
flaw.low_self_esteem.summary: You have a deflated opinion of your own self-worth.

flaw.low_tolerance.name: Low Tolerance
flaw.low_tolerance.summary: The character cannot easily withstand pain and fatigue.

flaw.lycanthrope.name: Lycanthrope
flaw.lycanthrope.summary: You have been cursed to change form into a dangerous predator (such as a wolf, lynx, or bear) on nights of the full moon (or similar, monthly, astrological events).

flaw.magic_addiction.name: Magic Addiction
flaw.magic_addiction.summary: You crave the rush of casting and holding power over magic.

flaw.magical_air.name: Magical Air
flaw.magical_air.summary: People and animals react to you as if you had The Gift.

flaw.magical_being_companion.name: Magical {being} Companion
flaw.magical_being_companion.summary: The character is accompanied by an intelligent magical being, one that is smart enough to follow orders or disobey them on its own initiative, which the character must regularly look after.

flaw.magical_fascination.name: Magical Fascination
flaw.magical_fascination.summary: This character is intensely interested in supernatural and magical phenomena, to the exclusion of all other motivations.

flaw.manifest_sin.name: Manifest Sin
flaw.manifest_sin.summary: A sin or crime this character has committed in the past stains his spirit and is manifest to those who can perceive things hidden to mortal senses.

flaw.manufactured_ignorance.name: Manufactured Ignorance
flaw.manufactured_ignorance.summary: The tainted person has a delusion, but his mistaken belief is sustained by a group of minor demons that provide a stream of supporting evidence.

flaw.many_marriageable_daughters.name: Many Marriageable Daughters
flaw.many_marriageable_daughters.summary: The character has a lot of daughters and needs to participate in stories to marry them off suitably.

flaw.master_of_none.name: Master of None
flaw.master_of_none.summary: Either by choice or circumstance, this character never seems to be able to stick at a task or job for longer than a season, usually following the work as it moves through the year.

flaw.meddler_major.name: Meddler (Major)
flaw.meddler_major.summary: You want to fix other peoples' lives: arrange matches, teach children to sew "properly," or tend the sick.

flaw.meddler_minor.name: Meddler (Minor)
flaw.meddler_minor.summary: You want to fix other peoples' lives: arrange matches, teach children to sew "properly," or tend the sick.

flaw.mentor.name: Mentor
flaw.mentor.summary: A person of some importance, wealth, or wisdom has taken an interest in your life, and at times provides you with minor material aid and advice.

flaw.missing_ear.name: Missing Ear
flaw.missing_ear.summary: You cannot accurately locate the direction of sounds, and suffer a penalty of –3 to hearing rolls.

flaw.missing_eye.name: Missing Eye
flaw.missing_eye.summary: You cannot judge close distances easily and get –3 on Attack rolls for missiles and targeting rolls for spells.

flaw.missing_hand.name: Missing Hand
flaw.missing_hand.summary: Perhaps it was an accident or a punishment in your past that cost you one of your hands.

flaw.mistaken_identity.name: Mistaken Identity
flaw.mistaken_identity.summary: Someone, who looks exactly like you and whom you and your companions will most likely never meet, lives near you, and is responsible for an ongoing variety of violent, illegal, obscene, or embarrassing acts.

flaw.monastic_vows.name: Monastic Vows
flaw.monastic_vows.summary: You have taken vows of poverty, chastity, and obedience to a religious superior.

flaw.monastic_vows_hermetic.name: Monastic Vows (Hermetic)
flaw.monastic_vows_hermetic.summary: You have taken vows of poverty, chastity, and obedience to a religious superior, which means that you cannot own vis and must only possess functional magic devices.

flaw.monstrous_blood.name: Monstrous Blood
flaw.monstrous_blood.summary: The character's essential nature has been changed through exposure to the Magic realm, often because of a relationship to a magic being, which gives her true form unfortunate supernatural properties.

flaw.motion_sickness.name: Motion Sickness
flaw.motion_sickness.summary: Riding a horse, in a cart, or sailing on a ship makes you violently ill.

flaw.mute.name: Mute
flaw.mute.summary: You cannot speak; perhaps your tongue was cut out.

flaw.necessary_condition.name: Necessary Condition
flaw.necessary_condition.summary: In order for your magic to work, you must perform a specific action while casting any spell.

flaw.necessary_realm_aura_for_ability.name: Necessary {realm} Aura for {ability}
flaw.necessary_realm_aura_for_ability.summary: Due to some connection with a given supernatural realm, the absence of a given supernatural aura has a pronounced effect upon the character's ability to focus on certain tasks.

flaw.night_terrors.name: Night Terrors
flaw.night_terrors.summary: This character is plagued far too often by horrible nightmares and fits of screaming in his sleep.

flaw.no_sense_of_direction.name: No Sense of Direction
flaw.no_sense_of_direction.summary: You are completely unable to follow directions.

flaw.nocturnal.name: Nocturnal
flaw.nocturnal.summary: Your natural body rhythms try to keep you sleeping until noon.

flaw.noncombatant.name: Noncombatant
flaw.noncombatant.summary: You have no interest in combat, nor do you have any ability with it.

flaw.oath_of_fealty.name: Oath of Fealty
flaw.oath_of_fealty.summary: You have sworn an oath of loyalty and support to someone outside the covenant, and sometimes they call on you to uphold your vow.

flaw.obese.name: Obese
flaw.obese.summary: You are large because of fat, not muscle.

flaw.obsessed_major.name: Obsessed (Major)
flaw.obsessed_major.summary: You are fixated on some prized object, action, or ideal.

flaw.obsessed_minor.name: Obsessed (Minor)
flaw.obsessed_minor.summary: You are fixated on some prized object, action, or ideal.

flaw.offensive_to_beings.name: Offensive to {being}
flaw.offensive_to_beings.summary: This Flaw is associated with one of six classes of beings: animals, mundane humans, divine beings, faeries, demons, or magical creatures.

flaw.optimistic_major.name: Optimistic (Major)
flaw.optimistic_major.summary: You are convinced that everything will turn out for the best.

flaw.optimistic_minor.name: Optimistic (Minor)
flaw.optimistic_minor.summary: You are convinced that everything will turn out for the best.

flaw.outcast.name: Outcast
flaw.outcast.summary: You have the rough task of making it on your own—normal society rejects you and you are not attached to a covenant.

flaw.outlaw.name: Outlaw
flaw.outlaw.summary: You have been outlawed, and must live by your wits outside society.

flaw.outlaw_leader.name: Outlaw Leader
flaw.outlaw_leader.summary: You command a small group (three to six persons) of outlaws.

flaw.outsider_major.name: Outsider (Major)
flaw.outsider_major.summary: You belong to a group that is both readily identifiable and distrusted or disliked.

flaw.outsider_minor.name: Outsider (Minor)
flaw.outsider_minor.summary: You belong to a group that is both readily identifiable and distrusted or disliked.

flaw.overconfident_major.name: Overconfident (Major)
flaw.overconfident_major.summary: You have a completely unshakable faith in your own abilities.

flaw.overconfident_minor.name: Overconfident (Minor)
flaw.overconfident_minor.summary: You have a completely unshakable faith in your own abilities.

flaw.oversensitive_major.name: Oversensitive (Major)
flaw.oversensitive_major.summary: Something that others find merely unpleasant you consider intolerable.

flaw.oversensitive_minor.name: Oversensitive (Minor)
flaw.oversensitive_minor.summary: Something that others find merely unpleasant you consider intolerable.

flaw.pagan.name: Pagan
flaw.pagan.summary: You do not follow the Church and have never been baptized.

flaw.painful_magic.name: Painful Magic
flaw.painful_magic.summary: Casting spells causes you to suffer the equivalent of one Fatigue level in pain for each spell you cast.

flaw.palsied_hands.name: Palsied Hands
flaw.palsied_hands.summary: Your hands shake uncontrollably, which makes casting spells or holding objects difficult.

flaw.pious_major.name: Pious (Major)
flaw.pious_major.summary: You are a fervent follower of your religion.

flaw.pious_minor.name: Pious (Minor)
flaw.pious_minor.summary: You are a fervent follower of your religion.

flaw.plagued_by_supernatural_entity.name: Plagued by Supernatural Entity
flaw.plagued_by_supernatural_entity.summary: Some supernatural being interferes in your life on a fairly regular basis.

flaw.poor.name: Poor
flaw.poor.summary: You are a poor member of your social class: three seasons a year go to making ends meet, leaving one fewer season for any advancement other than exposure. Not available to magi, nor to anyone the covenant supports.

flaw.poor_characteristic.name: Poor {characteristic}
flaw.poor_characteristic.summary: Lower a Characteristic already at -3 down to -5; you still gain the points.

flaw.poor_concentration.name: Poor Concentration
flaw.poor_concentration.summary: While the character may have a mind that is quick to make decisions, he has a short attention span.

flaw.poor_formulaic_magic.name: Poor Formulaic Magic
flaw.poor_formulaic_magic.summary: You are simply not very good at Formulaic magic.

flaw.poor_living_conditions.name: Poor Living Conditions
flaw.poor_living_conditions.summary: Either because of this character's own poor living conditions, or those of people he is in frequent contact with, he is more susceptible to the rigors of daily life.

flaw.poor_memory.name: Poor Memory
flaw.poor_memory.summary: You have a very hard time recalling one type of thing, such as names, faces, or places.

flaw.poor_student.name: Poor Student
flaw.poor_student.summary: You are bad at learning from books and teachers.

flaw.primitive_equipment.name: Primitive Equipment
flaw.primitive_equipment.summary: The character is capable of using only the simplest tools and equipment.

flaw.primogeniture_lineage.name: Primogeniture Lineage
flaw.primogeniture_lineage.summary: The character is in line for Primus of House Verditius.

flaw.prohibition.name: Prohibition
flaw.prohibition.summary: You have had a Conditional Curse (also known as a "Geas") cast upon you and must obey the restrictions of your prohibition or be penalized by the curse.

flaw.proud_major.name: Proud (Major)
flaw.proud_major.summary: You believe that you are more important than just about everybody, and expect the appropriate respect.

flaw.proud_minor.name: Proud (Minor)
flaw.proud_minor.summary: You believe that you are more important than just about everybody, and expect the appropriate respect.

flaw.raised_from_the_dead.name: Raised from the Dead
flaw.raised_from_the_dead.summary: You died, and were brought back to life through a holy miracle.

flaw.raised_in_the_gutter.name: Raised in the Gutter
flaw.raised_in_the_gutter.summary: This character was raised on the margins of society.

flaw.realm_stigmatic.name: {realm} Stigmatic
flaw.realm_stigmatic.summary: The character occasionally manifests physical phenomena in the presence of supernatural powers.

flaw.rebellious_major.name: Rebellious (Major)
flaw.rebellious_major.summary: You react adversely to any attempt to impose authority over you, and work against those who are in command.

flaw.rebellious_minor.name: Rebellious (Minor)
flaw.rebellious_minor.summary: You react adversely to any attempt to impose authority over you, and work against those who are in command.

flaw.reckless_major.name: Reckless (Major)
flaw.reckless_major.summary: You tend not to notice that situations are threatening, and certainly do not stop to consider whether they might be.

flaw.reckless_minor.name: Reckless (Minor)
flaw.reckless_minor.summary: You tend not to notice that situations are threatening, and certainly do not stop to consider whether they might be.

flaw.reclusive.name: Reclusive
flaw.reclusive.summary: You do not like being disturbed or interrupted.

flaw.rector.name: Rector/Proctor
flaw.rector.summary: The character is the representative leader of his faculty or nation at a university, depending on whether he is a master or a student.

flaw.regular.name: Regular
flaw.regular.summary: The character lives according to a strict religious rule, which leaves little time for other activities.

flaw.repellent.name: Repellent
flaw.repellent.summary: The character has developed one of the physical characteristics of his demonic creator, which causes fear and revulsion among normal humans.

flaw.restricted_learning.name: Restricted Learning
flaw.restricted_learning.summary: The character is incapable of learning new things without assistance.

flaw.restricted_power.name: Restricted Power ({power})
flaw.restricted_power.summary: This Flaw limits the use of a supernatural power that can normally be used at will, such as those granted by the Focus Power, Greater Power, Lesser Power, Personal Power, and Ritual Power Virtues.

flaw.restriction.name: Restriction
flaw.restriction.summary: You cannot cast spells at all under certain uncommon conditions.

flaw.rigid_magic.name: Rigid Magic
flaw.rigid_magic.summary: You cannot use vis when you cast spells.

flaw.rolling_stone.name: Rolling Stone
flaw.rolling_stone.summary: The rolling stone gathers no moss, and neither does this character.

flaw.savantism.name: Savantism
flaw.savantism.summary: The character's family was cursed by faeries; his mother tripped over a hare while pregnant with him; or he was born on horseback.

flaw.secretive.name: Secretive
flaw.secretive.summary: The character is prone to keeping secrets from his sodales.

flaw.seeker.name: Seeker
flaw.seeker.summary: You are a self-proclaimed member of the Seekers, a loose organization of competitive magi searching for ancient magic and arcane artifacts.

flaw.servant_of_the_land.name: Servant of the {land}
flaw.servant_of_the_land.summary: Some powerful magical creature has saved the character from death or granted a similar boon, and in return the character has been set a task.

flaw.sheltered_upbringing.name: Sheltered Upbringing
flaw.sheltered_upbringing.summary: You grew up completely separated from society, knowing only your parents or mentor.

flaw.short_lived_magic.name: Short-Lived Magic
flaw.short_lived_magic.summary: Your spells do not last as long as they should.

flaw.short_of_breath.name: Short of Breath
flaw.short_of_breath.summary: The character cannot last as long as others when exerting himself and quickly tires during extended physical activity.

flaw.short_ranged_magic.name: Short-Ranged Magic
flaw.short_ranged_magic.summary: Halve your Casting Totals whenever you are not touching the target of the spell.

flaw.simple_minded.name: Simple-Minded
flaw.simple_minded.summary: You can only think about one thing at a time — guarding the bridge, hunting for a missing ring, or hiding in the trees for example.

flaw.sleep_disorder.name: Sleep Disorder
flaw.sleep_disorder.summary: More often than not, this character is unable to sleep soundly during the night.

flaw.slothful.name: Slothful
flaw.slothful.summary: The character is lazy and indolent, and enjoys nothing better than doing as little as possible.

flaw.slow_caster.name: Slow Caster
flaw.slow_caster.summary: Your magic requires more time to prepare and execute than that of other magi.

flaw.slow_power.name: Slow Power ({power})
flaw.slow_power.summary: One of the character's supernatural powers is very slow, so that it requires an additional round of preparation to activate.

flaw.slow_reflexes.name: Slow Reflexes
flaw.slow_reflexes.summary: The character does not react well to surprises.

flaw.small_frame.name: Small Frame
flaw.small_frame.summary: You are of a lighter-than-average build.

flaw.social_handicap.name: Social Handicap
flaw.social_handicap.summary: You have some trait that keeps you from interacting easily with other people.

flaw.soft_hearted.name: Soft-Hearted
flaw.soft_hearted.summary: You cannot bear to witness suffering, and causing it brings you sleepless nights.

flaw.spontaneous_casting_tools.name: Spontaneous Casting Tools
flaw.spontaneous_casting_tools.summary: The character must use casting tools to cast spontaneous spells just as he does for casting formulaic spells.

flaw.stigmatic_catalyst.name: Stigmatic Catalyst
flaw.stigmatic_catalyst.summary: The character's presence sometimes causes symbolic marks to appear on the bodies of people without Magic Resistance nearby.

flaw.stockade_parma_magica.name: Stockade Parma Magica
flaw.stockade_parma_magica.summary: Because of your restricted understanding of Parma Magica, you cannot suppress your Parma once it is erected.

flaw.stuck_in_your_ways.name: Stuck in Your Ways
flaw.stuck_in_your_ways.summary: Having come from a covenant, this character knows how things must be done to best serve the needs of covenfolk and magi alike.

flaw.study_requirement.name: Study Requirement
flaw.study_requirement.summary: You are unable to study magic from books or vis alone.

flaw.supernatural_nuisance.name: Supernatural Nuisance
flaw.supernatural_nuisance.summary: Supernatural entities of a certain kind interfere in your life in minor ways whenever you are around them.

flaw.suppressed_gift.name: Suppressed Gift
flaw.suppressed_gift.summary: The character has The Gift but cannot access its power, having temporarily lost his magical ability through mishap or some other misfortune.

flaw.surgical_empiricus.name: Surgical Empiricus
flaw.surgical_empiricus.summary: You are a chirurgeon by trade, but have never received a wide grounding in the subject; rather your training has focused on only a single aspect of Chirurgy.

flaw.susceptibility_to_divine_power.name: Susceptibility to Divine Power
flaw.susceptibility_to_divine_power.summary: You are especially sensitive to the Dominion and suffer twice the normal penalties (such as spellcasting modifiers and botch dice) to your magic when in a Divine aura.

flaw.susceptibility_to_faerie_power.name: Susceptibility to Faerie Power
flaw.susceptibility_to_faerie_power.summary: You are especially susceptible to the fay and their magic.

flaw.susceptibility_to_infernal_power.name: Susceptibility to Infernal Power
flaw.susceptibility_to_infernal_power.summary: You are especially vulnerable to the dark powers.

flaw.susceptibility_to_sunlight.name: Susceptibility to Sunlight
flaw.susceptibility_to_sunlight.summary: Direct, bright sunlight causes you noticeable pain and exhausts you.

flaw.susceptibility_to_warping.name: Susceptibility to Warping
flaw.susceptibility_to_warping.summary: Your character's constant exposure to magic has made him more susceptible to supernatural Warping than he might otherwise be.

flaw.tainted_offspring.name: Tainted Offspring
flaw.tainted_offspring.summary: The character has a child who has been marked for great, but unpleasant, things by a powerful demon.

flaw.tainted_with_evil.name: Tainted With Evil
flaw.tainted_with_evil.summary: An air of corruption surrounds you as a result of something you, your parents, or your ancestors did.

flaw.temperate.name: Temperate
flaw.temperate.summary: You do not over-indulge in any sensual pleasures.

flaw.the_constant_expression.name: The Constant Expression
flaw.the_constant_expression.summary: The maga forms the center of a magical maelstrom, perpetually casting non-fatiguing Spontaneous magic effects.

flaw.the_falling_evil.name: The Falling Evil
flaw.the_falling_evil.summary: The character occasionally suffers convulsions and blackouts.

flaw.tormenting_master.name: Tormenting Master
flaw.tormenting_master.summary: Your master does not believe you have successfully passed the apprentice's gauntlet (the test of becoming a magus).

flaw.tragic_life.name: Tragic Life
flaw.tragic_life.summary: Demons have manipulated your life to your own detriment; you are Tainted.

flaw.true_love_major.name: True Love (Major)
flaw.true_love_major.summary: You have found the one person meant for you in all of creation, and the bond between the two of you cannot be sundered.

flaw.true_love_minor.name: True Love (Minor)
flaw.true_love_minor.summary: You have found the one person meant for you in all of creation, and the bond between the two of you cannot be sundered.

flaw.twilight_prone.name: Twilight Prone
flaw.twilight_prone.summary: You either enjoy or cannot help running excessive amounts of magic through you when you cast spells.

flaw.tzadik_nistar.name: Tzadik Nistar
flaw.tzadik_nistar.summary: Your character is one of the Tzadikim Nistarim, one of the 36 hidden righteous upon which the continuation of the world relies.

flaw.unbaptized.name: Unbaptized
flaw.unbaptized.summary: You are a Christian who has never been baptized for whatever reason, perhaps because you have some kind of supernatural background that might be undone by the ceremony — many magi believe that baptism impairs The Gift.

flaw.unbearable_to_beings.name: Unbearable to {being}
flaw.unbearable_to_beings.summary: This Flaw is associated with one of three classes of beings: mundane humans, demons, or divine beings.

flaw.uncertain_faith.name: Uncertain Faith
flaw.uncertain_faith.summary: Whether through a flaw in the character's understanding of doctrine, a moral turmoil, the disheartening absolution of repeated sins, or exposure to conflicting philosophies, he finds it hard to fully express devotion to his faith.

flaw.uncontrollable_strength.name: Uncontrollable Strength
flaw.uncontrollable_strength.summary: This character doesn't know his own strength, and at times he has trouble controlling it.

flaw.unhappily_married.name: Unhappily Married
flaw.unhappily_married.summary: Young merchants often marry for financial reasons.

flaw.unimaginative_learner.name: Unimaginative Learner
flaw.unimaginative_learner.summary: You have trouble figuring things out for yourself.

flaw.uninspirational.name: Uninspirational
flaw.uninspirational.summary: This character is bland, boring, and simple, with almost no chance of ever getting noticed or enticing anyone.

flaw.university_dean.name: University Dean
flaw.university_dean.summary: The character is the head of a university, having already acquired his doctor in (faculty) license.

flaw.unlucky.name: Unlucky
flaw.unlucky.summary: The character is exceptionally unlucky, and is frequently dealt a bad hand by the forces of chance.

flaw.unnatural_magic.name: Unnatural Magic
flaw.unnatural_magic.summary: Because of the unreal and illusory nature of your magic, none of the character's Creo rituals have a permanent effect.

flaw.unpredictable_magic.name: Unpredictable Magic
flaw.unpredictable_magic.summary: You always roll a stress die when using magic, even if completely relaxed.

flaw.unruly_air.name: Unruly Air
flaw.unruly_air.summary: The character has a penchant for stirring up situations, making pleasant events better and unpleasant ones worse.

flaw.unspecialized.name: Unspecialized
flaw.unspecialized.summary: The character does not have any specialties for any of her Abilities.

flaw.unstructured_caster.name: Unstructured Caster
flaw.unstructured_caster.summary: You have never quite mastered the intricacies of spellcasting, and are unable to perform Formulaic magic without extreme effort.

flaw.usurer.name: Usurer
flaw.usurer.summary: You often lend silver or other valuables to people at interest rates that many consider abusive.

flaw.vendetta.name: Vendetta
flaw.vendetta.summary: The magus is engaged in one of House Verditius' vendettas, mostly likely carrying on his parens's vendetta against another Verditius magus.

flaw.vengeful_powers.name: Vengeful Powers
flaw.vengeful_powers.summary: The character has one or more non-Infernal Powers in which the Infernal realm has taken a personal interest.

flaw.viaticarus.name: Viaticarus
flaw.viaticarus.summary: At some point in the character's past, he was at death's door, and as a result a priest performed the sacrament of Extreme Unction.

flaw.visions.name: Visions
flaw.visions.summary: You often see images related to emotionally or magically laden events.

flaw.vow_major.name: Vow (Major)
flaw.vow_major.summary: You have sworn to do something difficult, and breaking your vow is a serious matter.

flaw.vow_minor.name: Vow (Minor)
flaw.vow_minor.summary: You have sworn to do something difficult, and breaking your vow is a serious matter.

flaw.vulnerable_casting.name: Vulnerable Casting
flaw.vulnerable_casting.summary: Some magi are better able to withstand the Fatigue loss of casting spells, and some less so.

flaw.vulnerable_magic.name: Vulnerable Magic
flaw.vulnerable_magic.summary: The character's magic is automatically dispelled in certain uncommon circumstances.

flaw.vulnerable_to_folk_tradition.name: Vulnerable to Folk Tradition
flaw.vulnerable_to_folk_tradition.summary: The magus's magic is susceptible to various folk-remedies for averting hostile spells.

flaw.wanderlust.name: Wanderlust
flaw.wanderlust.summary: The character feels compelled to travel with a passion that is so strong that he cannot spend more than a season in the same place.

flaw.warped_by_magic.name: Warped by Magic
flaw.warped_by_magic.summary: The character's adventures have exposed him to powerful magical forces that have left a mark on him.

flaw.warped_magic.name: Warped Magic
flaw.warped_magic.summary: Your magic is accompanied by some unpleasant side effect that always manifests itself the same way, but with increasing intensity according to the level of the spell.

flaw.warped_senses.name: Warped Senses
flaw.warped_senses.summary: The character has become overly sensitive to environmental conditions, which affects his behavior in certain uncommon circumstances.

flaw.waster_of_vis.name: Waster of Vis
flaw.waster_of_vis.summary: When you use raw vis you waste one guarter (rounded up) of the pawns you apply.

flaw.weak_characteristics.name: Weak Characteristics
flaw.weak_characteristics.summary: You have three fewer points to spend buying Characteristics than most characters.

flaw.weak_enchanter.name: Weak Enchanter
flaw.weak_enchanter.summary: Your Gift is ill attuned to creating enchanted devices.

flaw.weak_magic.name: Weak Magic
flaw.weak_magic.summary: Your magic is particularly bad at penetrating Magic Resistance.

flaw.weak_magic_resistance.name: Weak Magic Resistance
flaw.weak_magic_resistance.summary: Any form of Magic Resistance you generate is much weaker under relatively common circumstances which are fairly easy for an opponent to utilize, such as when you are wet or facing away from the caster of the spell.

flaw.weak_parens.name: Weak Parens
flaw.weak_parens.summary: You gain 60 fewer experience points and 30 fewer spell levels from apprenticeship.

flaw.weak_personality.name: Weak Personality
flaw.weak_personality.summary: This character doesn't feel strongly for or against anything and lacks the unique traits most people have to make them really stand out.

flaw.weak_scholar.name: Weak Scholar
flaw.weak_scholar.summary: You don't understand laboratory guidance very well.

flaw.weak_spontaneous_magic.name: Weak Spontaneous Magic
flaw.weak_spontaneous_magic.summary: You may not exert yourself when casting spontaneous magic, so you always divide your Casting Score by five.

flaw.weak_willed.name: Weak-Willed
flaw.weak_willed.summary: You look to others for guidance rather than to yourself.

flaw.weakness_major.name: Weakness (Major)
flaw.weakness_major.summary: You have a soft spot for some sort of object or person.

flaw.weakness_minor.name: Weakness (Minor)
flaw.weakness_minor.summary: You have a soft spot for some sort of object or person.

flaw.weird_magic.name: Weird Magic
flaw.weird_magic.summary: Your control over magic is somewhat loose, perhaps due to Twilight effects or idiosyncratic training.

flaw.witch_marks.name: Witch Marks
flaw.witch_marks.summary: The character has minor disfigurements that those skilled in folk lore recognize as belonging to diabolists.

flaw.wrathful_major.name: Wrathful (Major)
flaw.wrathful_major.summary: You are prone to anger over the smallest issues, and your rage when you are thwarted in something major is terrible to behold.

flaw.wrathful_minor.name: Wrathful (Minor)
flaw.wrathful_minor.summary: You are prone to anger over the smallest issues, and your rage when you are thwarted in something major is terrible to behold.

virtue.academic_concentration_subject.name: Academic Concentration {subject}
virtue.academic_concentration_subject.summary: The character has concentrated in one of the seven subjects of Artes Liberales, in preference to the other six.

virtue.adept_laboratory_student.name: Adept Laboratory Student
virtue.adept_laboratory_student.summary: You digest the instruction of others quite easily.

virtue.affinity_ability.name: Affinity with {ability}
virtue.affinity_ability.summary: Experience put into one Ability counts for half again, and that Ability is exempt from the age-based cap.

virtue.affinity_art.name: Affinity with {art}
virtue.affinity_art.summary: Experience put into one Art counts for half again. May be taken twice, for two Arts.

virtue.alim.name: 'Alim
virtue.alim.summary: You are a member of the religious elite.

virtue.all_according_to_plan.name: All According to Plan
virtue.all_according_to_plan.summary: Once per session, a player whose character has this Virtue can reroll a botch die.

virtue.alluring_to_beings.name: Alluring to {being}
virtue.alluring_to_beings.summary: This Virtue is associated with one of three classes of beings: mundane animals, faeries, or magical beings.

virtue.almogaten.name: Almogaten
virtue.almogaten.summary: The character is the leader of a band of Almogavars, chosen by his fellows for his skill and experience.

virtue.almogavar.name: Almogavar
virtue.almogavar.summary: The character is a member of a band of mercenaries and raiders, living a life of adventure according to a code of honor and discipline.

virtue.amorphous_major.name: Amorphous (Major)
virtue.amorphous_major.summary: The character is able to take on any human form, so long as it does not identifiably belong to a particular human being.

virtue.amorphous_minor.name: Amorphous (Minor)
virtue.amorphous_minor.summary: The character is able to take on any human form, so long as it does not identifiably belong to a particular human being.

virtue.animal_ken.name: Animal Ken
virtue.animal_ken.summary: You can communicate with animals as if they were human beings.

virtue.apprentice.name: Apprentice
virtue.apprentice.summary: This Virtue may be taken by a child character who has the Gift and who has been accepted by an experienced Hermetic magus, with the troupe's approval.

virtue.apt_student.name: Apt Student
virtue.apt_student.summary: You are particularly good at learning from others.

virtue.aptitude_for_sin.name: Aptitude for {sin}
virtue.aptitude_for_sin.summary: This catch-all Virtue is for those minor effects which demons grant to their victims to allow them to sin more effectively, and so more often.

virtue.arcane_lore.name: Arcane Lore
virtue.arcane_lore.summary: You may take Arcane Abilities during character generation.

virtue.archieunuch.name: Archieunuch
virtue.archieunuch.summary: You have risen to enjoy the status and privilege associated with the most important and talented eunuchs, the archieunuchs.

virtue.aristotelian_training.name: Aristotelian Training
virtue.aristotelian_training.summary: The character is trained in the New Aristotle, having received his instruction from a teacher using recently translated texts of Aristotle in preference to the normal curriculum.

virtue.atlantean_magic.name: Atlantean Magic
virtue.atlantean_magic.summary: The magus, or an ancestor in his lineage, has studied the magic of exiled Atlanteans and has developed several useful extensions to Hermetic magic.

virtue.baccalaureus.name: Baccalaureus
virtue.baccalaureus.summary: The character has completed a three-year program at a university to receive a baccalaureus artium (Bachelor of Arts degree).

virtue.beadle.name: Beadle
virtue.beadle.summary: The character is an assistant to a university dean.

virtue.bee_king.name: Bee King
virtue.bee_king.summary: Bee Kingship is the result of descent from particular faeries, and thus a form of faerie blood.

virtue.berserk.name: Berserk
virtue.berserk.summary: You are capable of entering a blinding rage when in combat or frustrating situations.

virtue.blood_of_the_nephilim.name: Blood of the Nephilim
virtue.blood_of_the_nephilim.summary: You descend from the Nephilim; your Size grows and you age very slowly.

virtue.book_learner.name: Book Learner
virtue.book_learner.summary: You have a talent for comprehending the writings of others.

virtue.boosted_magic.name: Boosted Magic
virtue.boosted_magic.summary: By spending a pawn of vis when casting Formulaic spells you may "boost" the Range, Duration, Target, or size of the effect by one magnitude.

virtue.brother_chaplain.name: Brother Chaplain
virtue.brother_chaplain.summary: You are a priest of a crusading order, which is like other priests except that your vow should include obedience and poverty, in addition to chastity.

virtue.brother_knight.name: Brother Knight
virtue.brother_knight.summary: You are a knight in a holy crusading order, and it is your duty to be ready to fight the infidel at any time.

virtue.brother_sergeant.name: Brother Sergeant
virtue.brother_sergeant.summary: You are a member of a crusading order, but not a knight or a nobleman.

virtue.bureaucrat.name: Bureaucrat
virtue.bureaucrat.summary: You are a member of the civil administration, probably a katib (KEH-tib, scribe or secretary) or watha'iqi (wa- THEH-i-qee, writer of legal documents).

virtue.capo.name: Capo
virtue.capo.summary: The character manages a trading company that has branches in at least two cities.

virtue.cathedral_school_master.name: Cathedral School Master
virtue.cathedral_school_master.summary: The character teaches at a cathedral school, one of the many that dot Mythic Europe.

virtue.cautious_sorcerer.name: Cautious Sorcerer
virtue.cautious_sorcerer.summary: You are very careful with magic, and are less likely to fail spectacularly if you do fail.

virtue.cautious_with_ability.name: Cautious with {ability}
virtue.cautious_with_ability.summary: You are very careful with a specific Ability, and are less likely to fail spectacularly if you do fail when using it.

virtue.clan_ilfetu.name: Clan Ilfetu
virtue.clan_ilfetu.summary: The character is a member of Clan Ilfetu within House Bjornaer, and has received extra training in the rituals of the House.

virtue.clerk.name: Clerk
virtue.clerk.summary: You are a member of the literate class and are either a professional scribe, accountant, lawyer, student, or functionary.

virtue.command_animals.name: Command Animals
virtue.command_animals.summary: The character has the ability to mentally command mundane examples of a species of animal usually associated with the demon who tainted him or her.

virtue.commanding_aura.name: Commanding Aura
virtue.commanding_aura.summary: This supernatural power is granted to characters by either the pope, or the Divine directly.

virtue.common_sense.name: Common Sense
virtue.common_sense.summary: Whenever you are about to do something contrary to what is sensible in the game setting, common sense (the storyguide) alerts you to the error.

virtue.convoluted_mind.name: Convoluted Mind
virtue.convoluted_mind.summary: The character has been exposed to the machinations of demons so often that he has developed a sense of how their minds work.

virtue.corpse_magic.name: Corpse Magic
virtue.corpse_magic.summary: This Virtue gives the character the Supernatural Ability of Corpse Magic, at a score of 1.

virtue.covenfolk.name: Covenfolk
virtue.covenfolk.summary: You are a member of the covenant staff, and may have lived there all your life.

virtue.craft_guild_training.name: Craft Guild Training
virtue.craft_guild_training.summary: This character has received above-average training during his apprenticeship, from a craft master or professional guild.

virtue.crafters_healing.name: Crafter's Healing
virtue.crafters_healing.summary: Like the smiths of ancient lore, the character can magically heal wounds by touching them with the tools of his trade.

virtue.craftsman.name: Craftsman
virtue.craftsman.summary: You live by making and selling goods.

virtue.curse_throwing.name: Curse-Throwing
virtue.curse_throwing.summary: Cure diseases and remove curses by transferring them to another. Confers the Curse-Throwing Ability.

virtue.custos.name: Custos
virtue.custos.summary: You are an employee of a covenant, but you have high status within the walls.

virtue.cyclic_magic_positive.name: Cyclic Magic (positive)
virtue.cyclic_magic_positive.summary: Your magic is attuned to some cycle of nature (solar, lunar, or seasonal, for example) and as such, is more potent at specific times.

virtue.death_prophecy.name: Death Prophecy
virtue.death_prophecy.summary: You have been blessed or cursed as to your fate.

virtue.deft_form.name: Deft Form
virtue.deft_form.summary: You are particularly skilled with one Form.

virtue.demonic_blood.name: Demonic Blood
virtue.demonic_blood.summary: A demon is your parent; you have an Infernal Might and Infernal Powers.

virtue.demonic_might.name: Demonic Might
virtue.demonic_might.summary: Increases your Infernal Might. Requires Demonic Blood.

virtue.demonic_powers.name: Demonic Powers
virtue.demonic_powers.summary: Grants extra levels of Infernal Powers. Requires Demonic Blood.

virtue.devil_child.name: Devil Child
virtue.devil_child.summary: Free status Virtue for a Mythic Companion born of demonic parents; incompatible with The Gift.

virtue.diedne_magic.name: Diedne Magic
virtue.diedne_magic.summary: Your magic lineage and traditions are from the druids and the vanquished former house of Diedne, making you especially skilled with Spontaneous magic.

virtue.doctor_in_faculty.name: Doctor in {faculty}
virtue.doctor_in_faculty.summary: The character has graduated from one of the higher faculties of a university, in medicine, civil or canon law, or theology, having already received his magister in artibus license, and may instruct fellow students.

virtue.domestic_animal.name: Domestic Animal
virtue.domestic_animal.summary: The character is an animal who is the property of a covenant or character, and is supplied with food and shelter.

virtue.dowsing.name: Dowsing
virtue.dowsing.summary: Find nearby things with a dowsing rod. Confers the Dowsing Ability.

virtue.dust_devil.name: Dust Devil
virtue.dust_devil.summary: This variant of the Skinchanger Virtue allows the character to adopt the shape of a tamzawit, or dust devil, a small whirlwind carrying dust.

virtue.educated.name: Educated
virtue.educated.summary: +50 experience points, spent only on Latin and Artes Liberales. You may buy Academic Abilities.

virtue.elemental_magic.name: Elemental Magic
virtue.elemental_magic.summary: You have been trained in the ability to manipulate raw elemental Forms (Aquam, Auram, Ignem, and Terram), and view them as a connected whole rather than four separate Arts.

virtue.embitterment.name: Embitterment
virtue.embitterment.summary: You may make someone hostile to a target of your choice.

virtue.emir.name: Emir
virtue.emir.summary: This is the same as the Knight Virtue, though due to the rather different upbringing of Muslim emirs, you are likely to be as skilled with hunting, religious teachings, and culture as you are with martial pursuits.

virtue.enchanting_ability.name: Enchanting {ability}
virtue.enchanting_ability.summary: When you set your mind to it, you can magically induce emotions and beliefs in others with a particular kind of artistic expression: music, dance, drawing, storytelling, even craftwork.

virtue.enduring_constitution.name: Enduring Constitution
virtue.enduring_constitution.summary: You can withstand pain and fatigue.

virtue.enduring_magic.name: Enduring Magic
virtue.enduring_magic.summary: The effects of your spells tend to last longer than usual (though Concentration, Momentary, and Ring spells remain just that).

virtue.enticer_of_multitudes.name: Enticer of Multitudes
virtue.enticer_of_multitudes.summary: The character has a version of the Inspirational Virtue that can only be used to manipulate people toward evil acts.

virtue.entrancement.name: Entrancement
virtue.entrancement.summary: You have the power to control another's will by staring into their eyes and giving them a verbal command.

virtue.eunuch.name: Eunuch
virtue.eunuch.summary: You have been educated and trained to serve the Byzantine nobility as a courtier, steward, chamberlain, scribe, lawyer, or accountant.

virtue.exotic_casting.name: Exotic Casting
virtue.exotic_casting.summary: The magus uses non-Hermetic methods to cast Hermetic spells.

virtue.extractor_of_form_vis.name: Extractor of {form} Vis
virtue.extractor_of_form_vis.summary: The magus can extract (Form) vis from a Magic aura, but only if the features of the aura exemplify the Form.

virtue.eye_of_hephaestus.name: Eye of Hephaestus
virtue.eye_of_hephaestus.summary: The character can innately tell the quality of a manufactured item.

virtue.fabric_ripper.name: Fabric Ripper
virtue.fabric_ripper.summary: The character has the supernatural ability to tear any manufactured thing made from plant or animal fibers.

virtue.factor.name: Factor
virtue.factor.summary: The character manages the interests of a trading house in a single city.

virtue.faerie_blood.name: Faerie Blood
virtue.faerie_blood.summary: Somewhere in your ancestry there is a faerie, and this relation gives you an intuitive grasp of the motivations and personalities of those supernatural folk.

virtue.faerie_doctor.name: Faerie Doctor
virtue.faerie_doctor.summary: Free status Virtue for a Mythic Companion who mediates between humans and the fae; incompatible with The Gift.

virtue.faerie_magic.name: Faerie Magic
virtue.faerie_magic.summary: Initiation into the Outer Mystery of House Merinita. Confers the Faerie Magic Ability at 1.

virtue.faerie_raised_magic.name: Faerie-Raised Magic
virtue.faerie_raised_magic.summary: The character's experience with faeries and the Faerie realm has conditioned him to invent spells very quickly; to him, Formulaic spells seem like inherent powers that you can learn through observation and experimentation.

virtue.failed_apprentice.name: Failed Apprentice
virtue.failed_apprentice.summary: You were once apprenticed to a mage, but something kept you from completing your studies.

virtue.falconer.name: Falconer
virtue.falconer.summary: The character trains hawks and falcons for a noble patron, and is responsible for the training, breeding, and health of the animals.

virtue.falls_like_a_cat.name: Falls Like a Cat
virtue.falls_like_a_cat.summary: The character is not injured by falls of up to three times his height, or six times his height if he can soften his fall by catching on windowsills, breaking through awnings, or hitting branches on the way down.

virtue.familiarity_with_the_fae.name: Familiarity with the Fae
virtue.familiarity_with_the_fae.summary: You have a natural understanding of faerie ways, perhaps due to spending time among them.

virtue.famous.name: Famous
virtue.famous.summary: You have a good Reputation of level 4.

virtue.fast_caster.name: Fast Caster
virtue.fast_caster.summary: Your magic takes less time to perform than that of other magi.

virtue.feather_messenger.name: Feather Messenger
virtue.feather_messenger.summary: This Virtue is only available to a character who can take the form of a bird (which may be her natural form).

virtue.ferocity.name: Ferocity
virtue.ferocity.summary: Like companion and magus characters, this character has Confidence points.

virtue.fidai.name: Fida'i
virtue.fidai.summary: The character is an assassin of the Nizari Isma'ilis.

virtue.finding_hidden_loot.name: Finding Hidden Loot
virtue.finding_hidden_loot.summary: A character with this Virtue gains a +9 bonus to Awareness rolls when searching a confined space for hidden items, provided they can move the contents of the space about undisturbed.

virtue.flawless_magic.name: Flawless Magic
virtue.flawless_magic.summary: You automatically master every spell that you learn.

virtue.flexible_formulaic_magic.name: Flexible Formulaic Magic
virtue.flexible_formulaic_magic.summary: You can vary the effects of Formulaic spells to a slight degree, while still getting the benefits of casting known magic.

virtue.focus_power.name: Focus Power
virtue.focus_power.summary: The character has a supernatural power with a narrow range of effects, like the ability to cast Spontaneous spells that are associated with a single type of magic.

virtue.folk_magic.name: Folk Magic {category}
virtue.folk_magic.summary: The character is capable of performing very minor acts of magic through his knowledge of scraps of occult lore.

virtue.font_of_knowledge.name: Font of Knowledge
virtue.font_of_knowledge.summary: You have supernatural access to information you have never learned.

virtue.forge_companion.name: Forge-Companion
virtue.forge_companion.summary: The character is an unGifted craftsman attached to a Verditius magus and working for him in his lab.

virtue.forgettable_face.name: Forgettable Face
virtue.forgettable_face.summary: Never will this character be the one noticed or picked out of a crowd.

virtue.free_expression.name: Free Expression
virtue.free_expression.summary: You have the imagination and creativity needed to compose a new ballad or to paint an original picture, and have the potential to be a great artist.

virtue.free_study.name: Free Study
virtue.free_study.summary: You are better at figuring things out for yourself than you are at poring over books.

virtue.frightful_presence.name: Frightful Presence
virtue.frightful_presence.summary: You are capable of instilling great dread through your appearance.

virtue.gender_shift.name: Gender Shift
virtue.gender_shift.summary: Each midnight, the character may choose to change genders.

virtue.gentle_gift.name: Gentle Gift
virtue.gentle_gift.summary: Your Gift does not disturb others.

virtue.gentleman.name: Gentleman/woman
virtue.gentleman.summary: You are a minor member (possibly illegitimate) of a noble family.

virtue.giant_blood.name: Giant Blood
virtue.giant_blood.summary: The blood of the ancient race of giants flows in your veins.

virtue.good_teacher.name: Good Teacher
virtue.good_teacher.summary: You can explain new concepts and skills with great facility.

virtue.gorgiastic.name: Gorgiastic
virtue.gorgiastic.summary: These magi, or their ancestors, have rejected the teachings of House Criamon and left the House.

virtue.gossip.name: Gossip
virtue.gossip.summary: You have regular social contacts in the area that provide you with all kinds of information about local social and political goingson.

virtue.great_characteristic.name: Great {characteristic}
virtue.great_characteristic.summary: Raise a Characteristic already at +3 up to +5; you still pay the points.

virtue.greater_benediction.name: Greater Benediction
virtue.greater_benediction.summary: You have been blessed by some supernatural power.

virtue.greater_immunity.name: Greater Immunity
virtue.greater_immunity.summary: You are completely immune to one common, potentially deadly hazard.

virtue.greater_power.name: Greater Power
virtue.greater_power.summary: The character has a supernatural power that he can activate at will.

virtue.greater_purifying_touch.name: Greater Purifying Touch
virtue.greater_purifying_touch.summary: You can, with a touch and the expenditure of a Fatigue level, cure a single serious disease.

virtue.guardian_angel.name: Guardian Angel
virtue.guardian_angel.summary: You have learned to hear the words of a divine watcher who gives you practical and spiritual advice.

virtue.guest_of_house_criamon.name: Guest of House Criamon
virtue.guest_of_house_criamon.summary: Magi with this Virtue are, politically, members of House Criamon, but may be created using the rules for any other House.

virtue.guild_apprentice.name: Guild Apprentice
virtue.guild_apprentice.summary: The character is a youth between the ages of 10 and 20 who is learning his trade from a guild master or journeyman.

virtue.guild_dean.name: Guild Dean
virtue.guild_dean.summary: The character is the ultimate authority of his guild, the man who decides many of the important decisions that face the guild and represents it politically.

virtue.guild_master.name: Guild Master
virtue.guild_master.summary: The character is a guild master and may legally practice his trade in town, and hire journeymen to work for him.

virtue.harnessed_magic.name: Harnessed Magic
virtue.harnessed_magic.summary: You have great control over your spells.

virtue.heartbeast.name: Heartbeast
virtue.heartbeast.summary: Initiation into the Outer Mystery of House Bjornaer. Confers the Heartbeast Ability at 1.

virtue.hermetic_experience.name: Hermetic Experience
virtue.hermetic_experience.summary: The character has experience with the magi of the Order of Hermes.

virtue.hermetic_magus.name: Hermetic Magus
virtue.hermetic_magus.summary: You are a member of the Order of Hermes.

virtue.hermetic_prestige.name: Hermetic Prestige
virtue.hermetic_prestige.summary: Other magi look up to you. You gain a Reputation of level 4 within the Order.

virtue.hex.name: Hex
virtue.hex.summary: The character has the ability to curse her enemies, making dire predictions about their future, which tend to come true.

virtue.homing_instinct.name: Homing Instinct
virtue.homing_instinct.summary: The character always knows precisely how to get from where she is to a number of locations equal to her Intelligence Score (a minimum of 1).

virtue.imbued_with_the_spirit_of_form.name: Imbued with the Spirit of {form}
virtue.imbued_with_the_spirit_of_form.summary: The magus has absorbed some of the powers of an elemental or other magic object (perhaps by consuming it).

virtue.immune_to_disease.name: Immune to Disease
virtue.immune_to_disease.summary: The character is marked as the property of a very powerful demon, and the lesser demons that cause most diseases refuse to harm him.

virtue.immunity_to_cold.name: Immunity to Cold
virtue.immunity_to_cold.summary: Normal cold does not harm you, nor does it make you feel uncomfortable.

virtue.improved_characteristics.name: Improved Characteristics
virtue.improved_characteristics.summary: +3 points to spend on Characteristics. May be taken multiple times.

virtue.independent_study.name: Independent Study
virtue.independent_study.summary: The character develops new skills extremely quickly on his own.

virtue.indescribable_face.name: Indescribable Face
virtue.indescribable_face.summary: After meeting this character, other characters usually find it hard to describe him sufficiently well to separate him from others.

virtue.induction.name: Induction
virtue.induction.summary: The character has the supernatural power to make people experience things that are not there.

virtue.ineslemen.name: Ineslemen
virtue.ineslemen.summary: This character is a member of one of the designated religious tribes of the Tuareg and is therefore accorded some authority over disputes and immunity from the usual feudal demands of the nobles.

virtue.infernal_heirloom.name: Infernal Heirloom
virtue.infernal_heirloom.summary: Infernal heirlooms are magical items that the character inherits from a diabolist, or, more rarely, finds.

virtue.inoffensive_to_beings.name: Inoffensive to {being}
