virtue.inoffensive_to_beings.summary: This Virtue is associated with one of five classes of beings: animals, divine beings, faeries, demons, or magical creatures.

virtue.inspirational.name: Inspirational
virtue.inspirational.summary: You are a stirring speaker or a heroic figure, and can urge people to great efforts.

virtue.intuition.name: Intuition
virtue.intuition.summary: You have a natural sensitivity that allows you to make the right decisions more often than luck can account for.

virtue.jack_of_all_trades.name: Jack-of-All-Trades
virtue.jack_of_all_trades.summary: The character is capable of turning his hand to almost anything.

virtue.journeyman.name: Journeyman
virtue.journeyman.summary: The character is a trained guild craftsman and may practice his trade in town under guild supervision.

virtue.jurist.name: Jurist
virtue.jurist.summary: The character is a judge, advocate, or procurator essentially a medieval lawyer in some capacity.

virtue.just_an_instant.name: Just an Instant
virtue.just_an_instant.summary: A character with this Virtue, who has had a few seconds to look about a room, does not need to make Awareness checks to detect or remember anything of interest on the room's exposed surfaces.

virtue.kassalan_exorcism.name: Kassalan Exorcism
virtue.kassalan_exorcism.summary: You are capable of performing minor exorcism spells through your knowledge of the rites of the Mortuary Society of Kassala in Alodia, the most remote of the three Nubian kingdoms on the southern reaches of the Nile.

virtue.keen_sense_of_smell.name: Keen Sense of Smell
virtue.keen_sense_of_smell.summary: The character's nose is more sensitive than normal for a human.

virtue.knight.name: Knight
virtue.knight.summary: You are a knight, a member of the noble classes and one of the elite warriors of Europe.

virtue.knows_people.name: Knows People
virtue.knows_people.summary: Your social contacts are not important for what they give you directly: they are important because they allow you to match up the desires of your various friends.

virtue.laborer.name: Laborer
virtue.laborer.summary: The character is a trained worker who practices a trade that is a valuable service to his community, but by which no finished good is produced.

virtue.land_regio_network.name: {land} Regio Network
virtue.land_regio_network.summary: The character has access to an extensive network of regiones, perhaps located in the depths of many lakes throughout Mythic Europe, or hidden above the clouds in the sky, or buried in subterranean caves under the ground.

virtue.landed_noble.name: Landed Noble
virtue.landed_noble.summary: You owe fealty and service to a higher noble, and control land, serfs, and men-at-arms.

virtue.lasiq.name: Lasiq
virtue.lasiq.summary: The character is an experienced assassin of the Nizari İsma'ilis, having successfully completed seven murders at the orders of his grand master, and commands a small band of up to six fida'is.

virtue.latent_magic_ability.name: Latent Magic Ability
virtue.latent_magic_ability.summary: You have a magical quality that has not yet manifested itself.

virtue.learn_ability_from_mistakes.name: Learn {ability} From Mistakes
virtue.learn_ability_from_mistakes.summary: You are able to improve a particular Ability through the expedient of repeated failure.

virtue.leather_ripper.name: Leather Ripper
virtue.leather_ripper.summary: This character has the supernatural ability to destroy a group of leather objects.

virtue.leper_magus.name: Leper Magus
virtue.leper_magus.summary: This Virtue describes the mystic legacy passed on from Tytalus to Hariste's line through the vector of leprosy.

virtue.lesser_benediction.name: Lesser Benediction
virtue.lesser_benediction.summary: You have been blessed by some supernatural power.

virtue.lesser_immunity.name: Lesser Immunity
virtue.lesser_immunity.summary: You are immune to some hazard which is either rare, or not deadly, or both.

virtue.lesser_power.name: Lesser Power
virtue.lesser_power.summary: The character has a supernatural power that he can activate at will.

virtue.lesser_purifying_touch.name: Lesser Purifying Touch
virtue.lesser_purifying_touch.summary: You can, with a touch and the expenditure of a Fatigue level, heal a specific illness.

virtue.license_of_absence.name: License of Absence
virtue.license_of_absence.summary: This priest character has a license of absence that relieves him from some duties.

virtue.life_boost.name: Life Boost
virtue.life_boost.summary: You may boost your Formulaic or Ritual spell casting totals by expending additional Fatigue levels.

virtue.life_linked_spontaneous_magic.name: Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic
virtue.life_linked_spontaneous_magic.summary: You can do more with spontaneous magic than most magi at the cost of your own life energy.

virtue.light_touch.name: Light Touch
virtue.light_touch.summary: You have especially good handeye coordination and great proficiency for using your hands in precise, fast ways.

virtue.lightning_reflexes.name: Lightning Reflexes
virtue.lightning_reflexes.summary: You respond to surprises almost instantly.

virtue.linguist.name: Linguist
virtue.linguist.summary: You are extremely proficient learning new languages.

virtue.lone_redcap.name: Lone Redcap
virtue.lone_redcap.summary: You are a Redcap who does not maintain ties to a Mercer House, and thus do not receive magic items or Longevity Rituals.

virtue.long_winded.name: Long-Winded
virtue.long_winded.summary: You can last longer when exerting yourself than most, and gain +3 on all your Fatigue rolls.

virtue.luck.name: Luck
virtue.luck.summary: You perform well in situations where luck is more of a factor than skill or talent.

virtue.lupus_the_wolf.name: Lupus (the Wolf)
virtue.lupus_the_wolf.summary: The character is employed by a university to watch over the students and ensure that they speak only Latin in their colleges and hostels.

virtue.magian_lineage_major.name: Magian Lineage (Major)
virtue.magian_lineage_major.summary: This Virtue makes the character a true blood descendent of the Median tribe of Magians, the original priestly caste of Persia.

virtue.magian_lineage_minor.name: Magian Lineage (Minor)
virtue.magian_lineage_minor.summary: This Virtue makes the character a true blood descendent of the Median tribe of Magians, the original priestly caste of Persia.

virtue.magic_items.name: Magic Items
virtue.magic_items.summary: You begin with 25 more starting levels of magic items than you would otherwise, and the rate at which your items are improved is increased by one level per year.

virtue.magic_sensitivity.name: Magic Sensitivity
virtue.magic_sensitivity.summary: You are often able to identify a place or object as magical.

virtue.magical_blood.name: Magical Blood
virtue.magical_blood.summary: The character's essential nature has been improved through exposure to the Magic realm, often from a magic being, which gives her true form special supernatural properties.

virtue.magical_memory.name: Magical Memory
virtue.magical_memory.summary: Your memory has been developed to remember magical rather than mundane things.

virtue.magical_mount.name: Magical Mount
virtue.magical_mount.summary: The character has a mount, beast-of-burden, or "guard dog," a creature that has Cunning instead of Intelligence and a Magic Might Score of up to 25.

virtue.magical_warder.name: Magical Warder
virtue.magical_warder.summary: The character has a magical being that accompanies him, watches over him, and sees that he comes to no harm.

virtue.magister_in_artibus.name: Magister in Artibus
virtue.magister_in_artibus.summary: You have incepted Master of Arts in one of the universities of Europe (Paris, Bologna, Oxford, Cambridge, Montpellier, Arezzo or Salamanca) and completed your two years' regency of compulsory teaching.

virtue.magister_in_medicina.name: Magister in Medicina
virtue.magister_in_medicina.summary: The character has achieved a doctorate in medicine from one of the medical schools of Europe (Salerno, Cremona, Montpellier, or Bologna), and completed his two years' compulsory teaching.

virtue.major_magical_focus.name: Major Magical Focus
virtue.major_magical_focus.summary: Your magic is much more potent in a fairly limited area, such as weather, necromancy, birds, or emotions.

virtue.maker_of_textured_vessels.name: Maker of Textured Vessels
virtue.maker_of_textured_vessels.summary: Textured vessels are those which have mystical patterns impressed into their surfaces before firing.

virtue.maker_of_water_vessels.name: Maker of Water Vessels
virtue.maker_of_water_vessels.summary: A character who drinks from a magical water vessel made by a character with this Virtue may swap one Ability score for the Craft: Potter score of the crafter at the time the vessel was made.

virtue.male_guild_sponsor.name: Male Guild Sponsor
virtue.male_guild_sponsor.summary: The character's father or husband is a guild craftsman and she has been allowed entry into his field of work, which is otherwise restricted to men.

virtue.mamluk.name: Mamluk
virtue.mamluk.summary: You are a former military slave, bought as a child, trained at a military school and educated in Islam, and then freed upon reaching adulthood.

virtue.marshal.name: Marshal
virtue.marshal.summary: A noble's stables require a specialist to coordinate the care, feeding, and welfare of the animals.

virtue.master_bard.name: Master Bard
virtue.master_bard.summary: The character has spent at least nine years of study at a bardic school and is a master of the trade, called an Anruth.

virtue.master_of_form_creatures.name: Master of {form} Creatures
virtue.master_of_form_creatures.summary: The character can tame animals and other unintelligent beings whose Magic Might is aligned with a particular Form.

virtue.master_of_kennels.name: Master of Kennels
virtue.master_of_kennels.summary: The character manages the kennels for a noble patron, and is responsible for the training, breeding, and health of the animals.

virtue.mastered_spells.name: Mastered Spells
virtue.mastered_spells.summary: You have fifty experience points to spend on mastering spells that you know.

virtue.masterpiece.name: Masterpiece
virtue.masterpiece.summary: For some benevolent reason, the magus's parens has allowed him to keep the lesser enchanted item he made to prove himself a magus and pass his Gauntlet.

virtue.mazdean_priest.name: Mazdean Priest
virtue.mazdean_priest.summary: Your character is an ordained Mazdean priest, initiated as a mobed.

virtue.mendicant_friar.name: Mendicant Friar
virtue.mendicant_friar.summary: You are a follower of St.

virtue.mentored_by_demons.name: Mentored by Demons
virtue.mentored_by_demons.summary: A character mentored by demons learns faster than is possible for those studying with human teachers, but demons only teach those Abilities that suit their plans for the character.

virtue.mercenary_captain.name: Mercenary Captain
virtue.mercenary_captain.summary: You lead a small company of mercenaries (5 to 10), for hire to the highest bidder.

virtue.merchant.name: Merchant
virtue.merchant.summary: You live from the buying and selling of goods.

virtue.merchant_adventurer.name: Merchant Adventurer
virtue.merchant_adventurer.summary: The character is in command of a ship, and a crew.

virtue.mercurian_magic.name: Mercurian Magic
virtue.mercurian_magic.summary: Your magical lineage and traditions are from the Roman priests of Mercury, which predate the Order of Hermes, making you especially skilled with Ritual Magic and magic used in conjunction with others.

virtue.method_caster.name: Method Caster
virtue.method_caster.summary: You are excellent at formulaic spells, as you have perfected a consistent and precise method for casting them.

virtue.mild_aging.name: Mild Aging
virtue.mild_aging.summary: The character's aging rolls benefit from a +1 bonus to the Living Conditions Modifier, in addition to whatever his social standing normally offers him.

virtue.minor_enchantments.name: Minor Enchantments
virtue.minor_enchantments.summary: The character has one or more items in his possession that have magical powers.

virtue.minor_magical_focus.name: Minor Magical Focus
virtue.minor_magical_focus.summary: Your magic is attuned to a narrow field; add the lowest applicable Art score twice within it.

virtue.muqta_muq_ta.name: Muqta' (Muq-Ta')
virtue.muqta_muq_ta.summary: You are an important emir, entrusted with an iqta' (iq-TAW', similar to a feudal fief).

virtue.muse.name: Muse
virtue.muse.summary: A muse possesses that rare beauty that encourages others to rise to worthiness.

virtue.mystical_choreography.name: Mystical Choreography
virtue.mystical_choreography.summary: The magus's skill at manipulating the shape and movement of the body allows him to reduce the amount of time required to perform Ceremonial Magic.

virtue.mythic_blood.name: Mythic Blood
virtue.mythic_blood.summary: You are a blood descendant of either a wizard of legend (possibly one of the Twelve Founders, or some other ancient and powerful sorcerer) or a supernatural being (such as a dragon).

virtue.natural_leader.name: Natural Leader
virtue.natural_leader.summary: The character is a dominant person with a demeanor that encourages others to do what he says.

virtue.nephilim.name: Nephilim
virtue.nephilim.summary: Free status Virtue for a divine giant of ancient myth; incompatible with The Gift.

virtue.notary.name: Notary
virtue.notary.summary: Notaries are legal officials employed by lords or towns.

virtue.nuntius.name: Nuntius
virtue.nuntius.summary: The character is a nuntius (messenger), charged with delivering messages, mail, and monetary donations between students and their families.

virtue.paid_rights.name: Paid Rights
virtue.paid_rights.summary: Medieval society has many prohibitions against women holding authority, reflected in the restriction of many Social Status Virtues to men.

virtue.partner.name: Partner
virtue.partner.summary: The character has a large financial stake in a wealthy trading company.

virtue.peasant.name: Peasant
virtue.peasant.summary: You live by working the land.

virtue.perfect_balance.name: Perfect Balance
virtue.perfect_balance.summary: You are skilled at keeping your balance, especially on narrow ledges or tightropes.

virtue.perfect_eye_for_commodity.name: Perfect Eye for {commodity}
virtue.perfect_eye_for_commodity.summary: For one commodity, and products manufactured from it, the character never fails to make an accurate assessment of value.

virtue.perfectus.name: Perfectus
virtue.perfectus.summary: You are one of the leaders of the Cathar heretics, found mainly in southern France.

virtue.performance_magic.name: Performance Magic
virtue.performance_magic.summary: In Mythic Europe, many Hermetic magi have learned how to disguise their magical practices by incorporating them fully into a mundane task or action at which they excel.

virtue.persona.name: Persona
virtue.persona.summary: The character may adopt one or more flawless disguises, changing both his physical appearance and mannerisms.

virtue.personal_power.name: Personal Power
virtue.personal_power.summary: The character has a supernatural power that he can activate at will.

virtue.personal_vis_source.name: Personal Vis Source
virtue.personal_vis_source.summary: You have exclusive access to a supply of raw vis.

virtue.physician_of_salerno.name: Physician of Salerno
virtue.physician_of_salerno.summary: The character has attended the famed School of Salerno, the pre-eminent source of medical learning.

virtue.piercing_gaze.name: Piercing Gaze
virtue.piercing_gaze.summary: By staring intently at people you make them feel uneasy, as if you are peering into their souls.

virtue.potent_magic_major.name: Potent Magic (Major)
virtue.potent_magic_major.summary: The maga's magic is particularly attuned to a narrow field, much as in a Magical Focus.

virtue.potent_magic_minor.name: Potent Magic (Minor)
virtue.potent_magic_minor.summary: The maga's magic is particularly attuned to a narrow field, much as in a Magical Focus.

virtue.powerful_relic.name: Powerful Relic
virtue.powerful_relic.summary: You own an unusually powerful relic with a True Faith score of 3.

virtue.premonitions.name: Premonitions
virtue.premonitions.summary: You sense when something is about to go wrong. Confers the Premonitions Ability at 1.

virtue.prestigious_student.name: Prestigious Student
virtue.prestigious_student.summary: The character is a son of a nobleman or a prosperous merchant, matriculated in a university that specializes in either Civil Law or Medicine.

virtue.priest.name: Priest
virtue.priest.summary: You have been ordained a priest, which means that you can carry out the sacraments of the Mass, Penance, and Extreme Unction.

virtue.privileged_upbringing.name: Privileged Upbringing
virtue.privileged_upbringing.summary: +50 experience points, spent only on General, Academic, or Martial Abilities.

virtue.protection.name: Protection
virtue.protection.summary: You are under the aegis of a powerful person, usually a noble or high-ranking Church official (though other options are possible, if the storyguide approves).

virtue.puissant_ability.name: Puissant {ability}
virtue.puissant_ability.summary: +2 to all rolls with one Ability.

virtue.puissant_art.name: Puissant {art}
virtue.puissant_art.summary: +3 to all totals using one Art. May be taken twice, for two Arts.

virtue.quiet_magic.name: Quiet Magic
virtue.quiet_magic.summary: You can cast spells using only a soft voice at no penalty, and at only a –5 penalty if you do not speak at all.

virtue.rabbi.name: Rabbi
virtue.rabbi.summary: Your character is an ordained Rabbi, a teacher and wise man of the Jewish community.

virtue.rard.name: Rard
virtue.rard.summary: The character has attended a bardic school and has passed the examination after four years, earning him the title of fili at the rank of Dos.

virtue.rat_up_a_drainpipe.name: Rat Up a Drainpipe
virtue.rat_up_a_drainpipe.summary: Using a mixture of acrobatics, climbing and dodging, this character can run through urban areas as if unobstructed.

virtue.redcap.name: Redcap
virtue.redcap.summary: Although you do not have The Gift and cannot work Hermetic magic, you are a full member of the Order of Hermes and of House Mercere (see page 15).

virtue.relic.name: Relic
virtue.relic.summary: You own a holy relic, such as the finger bone of a saint, with a True Faith Score of one.

virtue.religious.name: Religious
virtue.religious.summary: The character is a monk, a nun, a beguine, an anchoress or anchorite, a holy hermit, or similar.

virtue.reserves_of_strength.name: Reserves of Strength
virtue.reserves_of_strength.summary: Once per day, when in need, you can perform an incredible feat of strength.

virtue.ritual_power.name: Ritual Power
virtue.ritual_power.summary: The character has a supernatural power that he can activate at will.

virtue.rosh_beth_din.name: Rosh Beth Din
virtue.rosh_beth_din.summary: The Rosh Beth Din, or Head of the Court, presides at the Beth Din rabbinic court.

virtue.schooled_in_crime.name: Schooled in Crime
virtue.schooled_in_crime.summary: The character has been trained extensively in the criminal arts, and has 50 additional experience to spend on Abilities related to thievery.

virtue.second_sight.name: Second Sight
virtue.second_sight.summary: You see through illusion and concealment and perceive invisible things. Confers the Second Sight Ability at 1.

virtue.secondary_insight.name: Secondary Insight
virtue.secondary_insight.summary: Your method of magical study is especially versatile.

virtue.see_in_darkness.name: See in Darkness
virtue.see_in_darkness.summary: You can see in complete darkness.

virtue.self_confident.name: Self-Confident
virtue.self_confident.summary: You have a Confidence Score of 2 and start with five Confidence Points instead of three.

virtue.senior_bard.name: Senior Bard
virtue.senior_bard.summary: The character has spent five or six years at a bardic school, and is ranked a Cano or Cli respectively.

virtue.senior_clergy.name: Senior Clergy
virtue.senior_clergy.summary: The character is an archbishop, bishop, abbot, abbess, or other senior member of the Church.

virtue.senior_master.name: Senior Master
virtue.senior_master.summary: The character has been a prosperous guild master for a number of years and has risen to a position of authority in his guild.

virtue.sense_holiness_and_unholiness.name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
virtue.sense_holiness_and_unholiness.summary: Feel the presence of good and evil. Confers the Sense Holiness and Unholiness Ability.

virtue.sense_passions.name: Sense Passions
virtue.sense_passions.summary: The character can see into the hearts and minds of others, learning their weaknesses, fears, and evil thoughts.

virtue.shadchan.name: Shadchan
virtue.shadchan.summary: The shadchan is a marriage arranger, trusted by prospective parents to find the best matrimonial match for their sons and daughters.

virtue.shamash.name: Shamash
virtue.shamash.summary: The shamash is the servant of the synagogue and responsible for its well-being.

virtue.shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
virtue.shapeshifter.summary: You may change your shape into that of one or more mundane animals.

virtue.side_effect.name: Side Effect
virtue.side_effect.summary: Your magic has some incidental feature that is generally useful, though occasionally annoying.

virtue.simple_student.name: Simple Student
virtue.simple_student.summary: The character is a university student who is has not yet taken a degree.

virtue.skilled_parens.name: Skilled Parens
virtue.skilled_parens.summary: You gain 60 more experience points and 30 more spell levels during apprenticeship.

virtue.skilled_smuggler.name: Skilled Smuggler
virtue.skilled_smuggler.summary: The character can hide one item on his person, and attempts to find it suffer a –9 penalty on Awareness rolls.

virtue.skinchanger.name: Skinchanger
virtue.skinchanger.summary: You have a magical cloak, animal skin or similar item made from an animal.

virtue.skinchanger_dove.name: Skinchanger (Dove)
virtue.skinchanger_dove.summary: This is a more powerful variant of the Minor Virtue above.

virtue.social_contacts.name: Social Contacts
virtue.social_contacts.summary: You have a broad range of acquaintances in a specific social circle (specified when this Virtue is purchased), accumulated over years of travel and socializing.

virtue.sofer.name: Sofer
virtue.sofer.summary: The sofer is the scribe whose role it is to create a new Sefer Torah, or repair any fading or damage to an existing scroll, as required.

virtue.special_circumstances.name: Special Circumstances
virtue.special_circumstances.summary: You are able to perform magic better in certain uncommon situations (such as during a storm or while touching the target), gaining a +3 bonus to your Casting Scores and Magic Resistance.

virtue.spell_improvisation.name: Spell Improvisation
virtue.spell_improvisation.summary: The magus may add the magnitude of a Formulaic spell he knows as a bonus to his Casting Total when Spontaneously casting a spell that is similar to it (see Similar Spells, page 260).

virtue.spirit_votary.name: Spirit Votary
virtue.spirit_votary.summary: Free status Virtue for a devoted worshipper of a magical spirit; incompatible with The Gift.

virtue.spiritual_pact.name: Spiritual Pact
virtue.spiritual_pact.summary: A pact with a powerful Magical spirit that grants access to its power.

virtue.strong_angelic_heritage.name: Strong Angelic Heritage
virtue.strong_angelic_heritage.summary: Your angelic heritage grants a Divine Might and holy powers. Requires Blood of the Nephilim.

virtue.strong_faerie_blood.name: Strong Faerie Blood
virtue.strong_faerie_blood.summary: The blood of the fay is strong in you.

virtue.strong_willed.name: Strong-Willed
virtue.strong_willed.summary: You cannot easily be coerced into activities, beliefs, or feelings.

virtue.student_of_realm.name: Student of {realm}
virtue.student_of_realm.summary: You have been trained in the mystical aspects of one of the four realms of power (Divine, Faerie, Infernal, or Magic), and you have a +2 bonus on all uses of the appropriate Lore.

virtue.study_bonus.name: Study Bonus
virtue.study_bonus.summary: When given the opportunity to study an Art from books or raw vis in the presence of the Form or Technique, your surroundings give you new insights into your studies.

virtue.subtle_magic.name: Subtle Magic
virtue.subtle_magic.summary: You may cast spells without using gestures at no penalty.

virtue.sufi.name: Sufi
virtue.sufi.summary: You are a Muslim mystic, seeking a closer union with God through asceticism and rituals.

virtue.summon_animals.name: Summon Animals
virtue.summon_animals.summary: You are able to summon animals to your side.

virtue.supernatural_beauty.name: Supernatural Beauty
virtue.supernatural_beauty.summary: The character possesses that style of mystical beauty that, when threatened, calls royal power, folk magic, and heroism to its defense.

virtue.tainted_treasure.name: Tainted Treasure
virtue.tainted_treasure.summary: The character has inherited or acquired a vast amount of treasure, but it is cursed to cause harm.

virtue.templar_administrator.name: Templar Administrator
virtue.templar_administrator.summary: The character is technically a brother-knight or brothersergeant for the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon, but is really an administrator for the order's many holdings and activities.

virtue.templar_commander.name: Templar Commander
virtue.templar_commander.summary: The character is a commander within the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon and has authority over all aspects of the order in a province or preceptory.

virtue.templar_confrere_or_consoeur.name: Templar Confrere or Consoeur
virtue.templar_confrere_or_consoeur.summary: The character is an associate member of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon, and has taken one or two of the Templar vows.

virtue.templar_office_holder.name: Templar Office Holder
virtue.templar_office_holder.summary: The character holds a position within the local hierarchy of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon, such as the deputy commander, marshal, or infirmarer.

virtue.templar_prestige.name: Templar Prestige
virtue.templar_prestige.summary: A member of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon, the character enjoys great respect and admiration among his fellow brothers.

virtue.templar_servant.name: Templar Servant
virtue.templar_servant.summary: The character is a servant working at a commandery of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon.

virtue.templar_specialist.name: Templar Specialist
virtue.templar_specialist.summary: The character works as a skilled employee of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon, filling a crucial role for which the Templars have no full or associate member, such as craftsmen, blacksmiths, artisans, notaries, squires, soldiers, scribes, or translators.

virtue.temporal_influence.name: Temporal Influence
virtue.temporal_influence.summary: Through blood or a position of trust, you enjoy some political weight in society.

virtue.tethered_magic.name: Tethered Magic
virtue.tethered_magic.summary: You can pass control of your non-Ritual spells to others, just as if they were the caster, "tethering" the magic to them for the spell's duration.

virtue.the_enigma.name: The Enigma
virtue.the_enigma.summary: Initiation into the Outer Mystery of House Criamon. Confers Enigmatic Wisdom at 1.

virtue.the_gift.name: The Gift
virtue.the_gift.summary: You have the ability to work magic.

virtue.town_magistrate.name: Town Magistrate
virtue.town_magistrate.summary: The character has a position of judicial responsibility in a town, with a small staff of minor officials (up to five individuals).

virtue.trained_assassin.name: Trained Assassin
virtue.trained_assassin.summary: This Virtue is only available to characters with one of the Social Status Virtues of the Nizaris.

virtue.troubadour.name: Troubadour/Trobairitz
virtue.troubadour.summary: Troubadours are wandering minstrels and poets ("trobairitz" is the feminine form).

virtue.troupe_upbringing.name: Troupe Upbringing
virtue.troupe_upbringing.summary: You were raised among a group of entertainers, spending much of your childhood traveling from town to town.

virtue.true_faith.name: True Faith
virtue.true_faith.summary: Through piety and holy devotion you have faith that can move mountains.

virtue.true_love_pc.name: True Love (PC)
virtue.true_love_pc.summary: You have found the one person meant for you in all of creation, and the bond between the two of you cannot be sundered.

virtue.turb_trained.name: Turb Trained
virtue.turb_trained.summary: This character has grown up at the covenant, been trained to fight in the turb, and picked up a few things from the magi's trusted servants.

virtue.unaffected_by_the_gift.name: Unaffected by The Gift
virtue.unaffected_by_the_gift.summary: The character is not affected by the negative effects of The Gift or Magical Air in others.

virtue.unaging.name: Unaging
virtue.unaging.summary: You do not suffer the effects of age.

virtue.unbound_tongue.name: Unbound Tongue
virtue.unbound_tongue.summary: Whenever the character is transformed into a non-human form (whether by spell, magic item, curse, or a heartbeast) he may speak any human languages he knows with no impediment.

virtue.university_grammar_teacher.name: University Grammar Teacher
virtue.university_grammar_teacher.summary: The character is employed by a university to teach its younger members grammar.

virtue.variable_power.name: Variable Power ({power})
virtue.variable_power.summary: One of the character's magic powers (Greater, Lesser, Personal, or Ritual) becomes more powerful over time, based on either (age / 10), (Might Score / 5), Warping Score, or his score in an appropriate Ability.

virtue.venditor.name: Venditor
virtue.venditor.summary: The character is a venditor, a selling-agent for a Verditius maga, bartering her goods to other interested mundane parties.

virtue.venus_blessing.name: Venus' Blessing
virtue.venus_blessing.summary: People are often attracted to you.

virtue.verditius_magic.name: Verditius Magic
virtue.verditius_magic.summary: Initiation into the Outer Mystery of House Verditius, enabling the casting of enchantments through craft.

virtue.voice_of_the_land.name: Voice of the {land}
virtue.voice_of_the_land.summary: The character can speak with any creature whose natural habitat is a particular environment associated with this Virtue (including animals and magic beings), and the character is not normally perceived as either a threat or a prey object by these creatures.

virtue.wanderer.name: Wanderer
virtue.wanderer.summary: You are not tied to any community, and survive by doing casual work of some sort.

virtue.warrior.name: Warrior
virtue.warrior.summary: +50 experience points, spent only on Martial Abilities, which you may acquire at character creation.

virtue.ways_of_the_land.name: Ways Of The {land}
virtue.ways_of_the_land.summary: You have a deep understanding of a type of terrain, feeling more natural and at home there than anywhere else.

virtue.wealthy.name: Wealthy
virtue.wealthy.summary: You are a rich member of your class.

virtue.well_traveled.name: Well-Traveled
virtue.well_traveled.summary: You have journeyed extensively in this part of the world and find it easy to get along with people throughout the area.

virtue.whistle_up_the_wind.name: Whistle Up The Wind
virtue.whistle_up_the_wind.summary: You can create winds by whistling.

virtue.wilderness_sense.name: Wilderness Sense
virtue.wilderness_sense.summary: You are mystically attuned to the ways of the wilderness.

virtue.wisdom_from_ignorance.name: Wisdom from Ignorance
virtue.wisdom_from_ignorance.summary: One school of Sufis found in Egypt is particularly interested in calligraphy, and the aesthetics of the enigma.

virtue.wise_one.name: Wise One
virtue.wise_one.summary: A mystic, seer, or healer of good standing in the community.

virtue.withstand_casting.name: Withstand Casting
virtue.withstand_casting.summary: If a magus has this Virtue, then whenever he is about to lose Fatigue from casting a spell, he loses 1 less Fatigue level than normal, with a minimum of 1 Fatigue level — but if the spell would have been cast without Fatigue loss, then he still loses no Fatigue.
